title: In-Memory/Redis Database Platform Engineer
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

We are seeking an In-Memory Database Platform Engineer to join the Database Engineering team and help build, operate, and modernize enterprise in-memory database services. This mid-level role will support on-premises Redis deployments and multiple cloud-managed in-memory database offerings, with an emphasis on reliable operations, automation, security, performance, high availability, backup and recovery, and consistent engineering practices.  
  
The ideal candidate has practical Redis administration experience, solid Linux skills, and hands-on exposure to one or more cloud in-memory database services. The engineer will work closely with application, infrastructure, security, SRE, network, and cloud engineering teams while continuing to grow platform-design and troubleshooting expertise.

### **In-Memory Database Platform Engineering**

* Build, deploy, administer, and support production and non-production Redis environments across on-premises infrastructure and cloud-managed in-memory database services.
* Perform installation, configuration, patching, version upgrades, migrations, lifecycle management, and routine platform maintenance.
* Support Redis standalone, replication, and clustered architectures as applicable to the platform and workload.
* Apply engineering standards, reference configurations, operational controls, and documented best practices.
* Partner with application teams on connectivity, caching patterns, key design, data structures, performance, resilience, and operational readiness.

### **Multi-Cloud In-Memory Services**

* Support managed in-memory database offerings such as Amazon ElastiCache for Redis/Valkey, Amazon MemoryDB, Azure Managed Redis, and Google Cloud Memorystore, based on enterprise platform direction.
* Assist with provisioning, configuration, scaling, maintenance, monitoring, networking, access management, and migration activities across cloud environments.
* Help maintain consistent security, reliability, observability, and operational practices across on-premises and cloud implementations.

### **High Availability, Disaster Recovery, and Data Protection**

* Configure and support highly available Redis solutions using replication, clustering, multi-zone, or cloud-native resiliency capabilities.
* Configure and operate persistence, snapshot, backup, retention, restore, and recovery-validation processes where supported and required by the service.

### **Performance and Reliability**

* Monitor database availability, memory utilization, latency, throughput, replication health, capacity, and platform performance.
* Analyze and tune Redis configurations, memory policies, data structures, client behavior, connection patterns, hot keys, and workload characteristics.
* Troubleshoot production incidents, contribute to root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Participate in capacity planning, observability, operational health, and reliability improvements.

### **Security and Compliance**

* Implement and maintain authentication, authorization, least-privilege access, network controls, auditing, and credential-management integrations.
* Support private connectivity and identity/access controls for cloud-managed services.
* Assist with vulnerability remediation, compliance reviews, security assessments, and evidence requests.

### **Automation and DevOps**

* Develop and maintain automation for provisioning, configuration, deployment, patching, validation, monitoring, and routine operations.
* Use source control, APIs, CI/CD practices, configuration management, and Infrastructure as Code to improve consistency and repeatability.
* Contribute to safe self-service capabilities and reduction of manual operational work.

### **Platform Operations**

* Provide operational support for business-critical production and non-production in-memory database environments.
* Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, change management, and problem management.
* Create and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, standards, and operational documentation.
* Work independently on standard engineering tasks and partner with senior engineers on complex designs, migrations, and incidents.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 8+ years of database administration, database engineering, platform engineering, or related infrastructure experience.
* 4+ years of hands-on Redis administration or engineering experience in production or enterprise environments.
* Working knowledge of Redis architecture, persistence, replication, clustering, memory management, security, maintenance, and performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience with high availability, backup/recovery or persistence strategies, monitoring, capacity planning, and production support.
* Experience supporting at least one cloud-managed in-memory database service or comparable cloud database platform.
* Solid Linux administration and troubleshooting skills; RHEL or a comparable enterprise Linux distribution is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot database, operating system, storage, network, client-connectivity, and application-integration issues.
* Experience executing upgrades, patching, migrations, platform changes, and controlled production releases.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with more than one cloud in-memory offering, especially Amazon ElastiCache for Redis/Valkey, Amazon MemoryDB, Azure Managed Redis, or Google Cloud Memorystore.
* Experience with Redis Enterprise or Redis Software for on-premises platform management.
* Experience with Ansible automation for installation, configuration, patching, validation, or recurring operational tasks.
* Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or MySQL.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and delivery tooling such as Terraform, GitHub, GitLab, or CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or native cloud monitoring services.
* Exposure to Redis-compatible technologies such as Valkey is beneficial.

**Desired Attributes**
----------------------

* Strong ownership, customer focus, and attention to operational quality.
* Practical analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage priorities, follow engineering standards, and deliver assigned work with appropriate guidance.
* Strong collaboration, documentation, and communication skills.
* Interest in developing deeper expertise across in-memory platforms, automation, and multi-cloud database services.

  
  

**Primary Skills**

Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Web Services (AWS), Automation, Backup and Recovery, CI/CD, Database Administration, Database Design, Database Maintenance, Database Management, Database Management Systems (DBMS), Database Organization, Database Performance, Datadog, Data Modeling, Disaster Recovery (DR), Linux, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft PowerShell, Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB (Platform), MySQL Database Administration, Networking, Problem Management, Python (Programming Language), Redis {+ 5 more}

Hiral Parag Rughanihparb@allstate.com

**Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.**

title: Manager Product Development
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We're hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager in Bengaluru to lead a team that owns production software end to end — from what customers need, to how it's built, to how it runs. This is not a coordination role: you will still design systems, review code and get into incidents, while growing the people around you.

Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Y ou'll help shape how this team works, who joins it, and what it ships. Y ou'll report to the Director of Engineering and work closely with Product, Program Management, Customer Support and business stakeholders.

**What you'll own in your first year**

  

* A team and its outcomes. Lead a team of engineers (growing as we hire) and own what it delivers — measured by what changed for customers, not by tickets closed.
* Hiring. Help build the team: define what good looks like, interview, and close candidates.
* Quality as a first-class priority. Set the bar for testing, release and on-call so the team ships often without breaking customers.
* Technical direction. Make and document the architecture tradeoffs for your area, and stay close enough to the code to know when a design is wrong.
* People growth. Run 1:1s, give direct feedback, and create stretch paths so strong engineers grow faster than a standard promotion cycle.
* Own: Own it end to end with Speed, quality, depth and long term vision.

**What you must bring**

1. You have led engineers. At least 2 years directly managing a team — hiring, feedback,

performance conversations, growing people.

2. Tech-lead: A tech-lead role for at least 4 years.

3. You are still hands-on. Y ou've designed and built production systems in the recent

past, and you can review a pull request or a design doc and find the real problem in it.

4. You've owned multiple systems in production end to end. A system or product where

you were accountable for it working for customers — releases, incidents, and the

follow-through after.

5. You've delivered under ambiguity. You've taken a problem nobody had fully defined — a new product, an inherited system, a team in transition — and turned it into something

shipped.

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.

**Technical background**

  

* You've built and run production systems with a modern stack, such as: Cloud: AWS — you've designed, deployed and operated services on it, not just consumed them.
* Languages: one or more modern languages such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
* Databases, in depth: data modeling, query and index optimization, and scaling (replication, partitioning, caching). Y ou can walk us through a data model you designed and a performance problem you fixed, with the before and after.

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.

**What sets great candidates apart**

  

* Impact you can explain. You can name a result, the baseline it moved from, and how your team got there. You've also stopped or cut something that wasn't working. Teams you've grown. People you hired or coached who went on to bigger roles, and a team that got measurably better at shipping under you.
* Scale and complexity. Y ou've handled real load, real data volume or a genuinely hard domain — and can tell the story of one hard technical problem in detail.
* Inherited systems. You've taken over a codebase or product from another team or location and made it better without stopping delivery.
* Quality discipline. Y ou've raised a team's bar on testing, releases or incident response, and can show what changed.
* Cross-functional range. You've worked directly with product, support and business partners, and made scoping calls rather than just executing them.
* Framework mindset: You have a framework mindset and find opportunities to covert a custom implementation into a framework.

**What we look for in everyone we hire**

Whatever the role, we hire for six things. For a manager, each one also shows up in the team you build.

* Independence. Y ou don't need a roadmap handed to you. Y ou find the problem worth solving and get it done with little hand-holding — and you build a team that works the same way. Y ou will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey.

* Depth. At least one system or domain you could talk about for an hour, down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Y ears in a role aren't depth; complexity handled is.

title: Senior Performance Test Specialist
description:
**Senior Performance Test Specialist**

**Esko | Veralto Corporation**  
Location: Bangalore, India | Hybrid  
Reports To: Senior Team Leader

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Performance Test Specialist to independently design realistic workload simulations and own performance, scalability, stability, and capacity testing for WebCenter Enterprise, a Java/J2EE web application. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in JMeter and complementary performance-testing tools, test scripting, workload modelling, statistical analysis of results, and evidence-based root-cause analysis across application, JVM, database, search, and infrastructure layers. You will partner with development and infrastructure colleagues to translate findings into prioritized recommendations and verified improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design realistic load, stress, spike, endurance, scalability, and capacity simulations based on user behaviour, transaction flows, concurrency, data volumes, pacing, and production-like workload distributions.
* Develop and maintain reusable JMeter frameworks and scripts for web applications and APIs, including correlation, parameterization, dynamic test data, assertions, distributed execution, and automated result collection. Use LoadRunner, Gatling, k6, or other tools where appropriate.
* Define workload models, baselines, SLAs, and acceptance criteria with stakeholders.
* Analyze response-time distributions and percentiles, throughput, errors, variability, saturation points, and resource trends; distinguish repeatable patterns from noise, outliers, and environmental variation.
* Diagnose Java/JVM issues using JFR, heap and thread dumps, GC logs, Eclipse MAT, jcmd, and related tools, including memory leaks, OOM errors, high CPU, thread contention, and connection-pool bottlenecks.
* Analyze and tune performance across JBoss/WildFly, Tomcat, SQL Server, REST APIs, and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch in collaboration with development and infrastructure teams.
* Correlate transaction timings, logs, traces, diagnostics, database behaviour, and cloud/infrastructure metrics to identify and quantify root causes.
* Form and test hypotheses, recommend prioritized improvements, and rerun controlled tests to verify benefits and prevent regressions.
* Integrate repeatable performance checks into CI/CD pipelines and maintain controlled environments, baselines, and versioned test assets.
* Plan investigations independently, estimate effort, manage dependencies and risks, validate test-environment and load-generator constraints, and document reproducible findings.
* Use approved AI tools where appropriate for scripting, diagnostics, and reporting; validate outputs and protect proprietary and customer data.

**Required Skills**

* 8+ years of testing experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on performance testing and engineering, with independent delivery of complex investigations.
* Advanced JMeter experience designing, scripting, debugging, executing, and maintaining realistic simulations for enterprise web applications and APIs, including distributed load generation, correlation, parameterization, dynamic test data, workload modelling, and automated result collection.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret percentiles, distributions, throughput, errors, variability, saturation behaviour, and resource correlations; distinguish meaningful findings from noise; and communicate evidence-based root causes, capacity limits, and recommendations.
* Hands-on Java/JVM performance diagnosis using profiling data, JFR, heap and thread dumps, GC logs, Eclipse MAT, jcmd, or comparable tools.
* Performance-analysis experience across JBoss/WildFly or Tomcat, SQL Server, and REST APIs.
* Experience with monitoring and APM tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or Datadog for cross-layer correlation and root-cause analysis.
* Experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure, Linux and Windows, Git, and CI/CD pipelines for repeatable performance-test execution.
* Ability to use Python, PowerShell, Bash, Java, or similar languages for test-data generation, execution automation, result processing, statistical analysis, and repeatable reporting.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with OpenSearch/Elasticsearch performance analysis.
* Experience with LoadRunner, Gatling, or k6 in addition to JMeter.
* Effective use of AI-assisted tools for performance scripting, analysis, or diagnostics, with critical validation of outputs.

**About Esko**

Our integrated platform and comprehensive tools empower retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to manage best-in-class packaging design and print processes. Innovation is built into the DNA of our business: every day, we challenge ourselves to be better by seeking out new ways to elevate our products, our processes, and our people. We also know that innovation and ingenuity starts with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.

  

**About Veralto**

Esko is proud to be part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment *where purpose meets possibility*: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. title: Senior Researcher - Physical AI & Robot Learning
description:
Job Description

Senior Researcher - Physical AI & Robot Learning

Job Location: Bangalore

Location Flexibility: Primary Location Only

Req Id: 13630

Posting Start Date: 10/28/26

Fujitsu’s R&D vision is to create cutting-edge technologies that support society and prioritize the flow of data. Our five key technologies are essential elements for collecting data from all parts of society, transporting it over ultra-high-speed and secure networks, analyzing it with trusted AI, converting it into value, and returning it to society. Central to realizing our strategy and vision are the people behind our R&D initiatives. We strive to foster top-notch talent in the innovation process by nurturing skilled individuals equipped to advance this cause with originality and dedication.

  

**Website:** https://www.fujitsu.com/global/about/research/

**Researcher – Physical AI and Robot Learning**
===============================================

**About the Role**
------------------

Fujitsu Research India (FRIPL) is building a **Physical AI Lab** to create robots that can perceive, reason, plan, learn, and act reliably in complex real-world environments.

We are seeking an exceptional researcher with a PhD and a strong record of advancing **robotics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, or embodied intelligence** through rigorous research and physical-robot validation.

The successful candidate will shape novel research in **robot learning and control** , while connecting perception, task planning, world models, and action execution into dependable end-to-end robotic systems. The role is intended for researchers who can convert ambitious scientific ideas into reproducible, measurable, and deployable capabilities.

### **Core Hiring Principle**

* Broad familiarity across **reinforcement learning, control, task planning, VLA models, and world models**
* Genuine research depth in **at least two areas**
* Evidence of **physical-robot implementation is mandatory**

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Research and Algorithm Development**
-----------------------------------------

* Conduct world-class research in **Physical AI, embodied intelligence, robot learning, planning, and autonomous decision-making**
* Develop novel methods in:
  + Reinforcement learning
  + Imitation learning
  + Learning-based control
  + Model-based RL
  + Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models
  + World models
  + Long-horizon task planning
* Design agents that connect semantic reasoning and task planning with motion generation, control, and closed-loop execution
* Advance robustness, safety, generalization, adaptation, and data efficiency for robots operating under real-world uncertainty

**2. Physical-Robot Deployment and Evaluation**
-----------------------------------------------

* Train, evaluate, and deploy policies on **physical robots** . Simulation-only experimentation is not sufficient for this role.
* Address:
  + Sim-to-real transfer
  + System identification
  + Domain randomization
  + Online adaptation
  + Latency
  + Sensing uncertainty
  + Failure recovery
* Design rigorous experiments, benchmarks, ablations, and evaluation protocols to measure task success, reliability, safety, and generalization
* Produce reproducible research assets including well-engineered code, experiment documentation, datasets, and robot demonstrations

**3. End-to-End Physical AI Systems**
-------------------------------------

* Integrate:

  + Perception
  + State estimation
  + Semantic understanding
  + Task planning
  + Motion planning
  + Learning
  + Control
  + Safety mechanisms

  into complete robotic systems.
* Collaborate closely with researchers across AI, computer vision, controls, planning, systems, and robotic hardware
* Contribute to scalable robot-data collection and learning pipelines for manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, or multi-robot settings

**4. Scientific and Strategic Impact**
--------------------------------------

* Publish influential research at premier AI, computer vision, and robotics venues
* Generate patents and contribute to technology transfer, open-source software, datasets, and benchmark development, as appropriate
* Mentor junior researchers and support research strategy
* Communicate technical results clearly to expert and business stakeholders
* Build collaborations with leading academic and industrial research groups

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

**Education and Research Excellence**
-------------------------------------

* Completed PhD, or PhD expected before joining, in:
  + Robotics
  + Artificial Intelligence
  + Machine Learning
  + Computer Science
  + Electrical Engineering
  + Control
  + Mechanical Engineering
  + Or a closely related discipline
* Proven publication record, including meaningful first-author contributions at leading venues such as **ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, IEEE Transactions on Robotics, IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters, Science Robotics, Nature Machine Intelligence** , or comparable venues
* Ability to identify important research problems, formulate technically sound solutions, and evaluate them with scientific rigor

**Real-Robot Evidence**
-----------------------

* Demonstrated implementation and evaluation on **physical robots** , supported by publications, project pages, videos, open-source code, datasets, competition results, or deployment outcomes
* Hands-on ability to diagnose the gap between algorithmic performance in simulation and behavior on real hardware
* **Simulation-only experience is insufficient**

**Technical Depth**
-------------------

Candidates should have research depth in **at least two** of the following:

* Reinforcement learning
* Imitation learning
* Robot control
* Task planning
* Motion planning
* World models
* VLA models
* Foundation models for robotics
* Embodied AI
* Multi-robot systems

In addition:

* Working familiarity with the broader Physical AI stack covering perception, planning, learning, control, system integration, safety, and evaluation
* Strong programming ability in **Python and PyTorch or JAX**
* Practical experience with **C++, ROS/ROS2** , and robotics simulation platforms such as **MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or Isaac Lab**
* Strong experimental methodology, problem-solving ability, technical writing, and verbal communication

**Preferred Experience**
========================

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Robotic manipulation, bimanual or dexterous manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, or human-robot collaboration
* Offline RL, diffusion policies, behavior cloning, self-supervised learning, model-based RL, or test-time adaptation
* Long-horizon task planning, hierarchical policies, memory-augmented agents, neuro-symbolic reasoning, or closed-loop replanning
* Multimodal foundation-model pre-training or post-training, vision-language models, VLA systems, or LLM-guided robotic reasoning
* Sim-to-real transfer, domain randomization, system identification, uncertainty estimation, safety-critical autonomy, or failure recovery
* Large-scale robot datasets, distributed training, scalable evaluation infrastructure, or real-time robotic systems
* Industrial robotics applications in manufacturing, logistics, inspection, service robotics, or warehouse automation

**Evidence of Exceptional Impact**
==================================

Strong consideration will be given to candidates demonstrating one or more of the following:

* High-impact publications or research recognized by the robotics, AI, or computer vision community
* Open-source tools, datasets, or benchmarks adopted beyond the candidate's immediate research group
* Leadership in major robotics projects or interdisciplinary teams
* Patents, technology transfer, or successful deployment of learning-based robotic systems
* Clear evidence of translating research ideas into **reliable physical-robot capabilities**

description:

Job Description

We are looking for a Junior GenAI Support Engineer to join Global DevOps Support at PDC, supporting the operational backbone behind the GenAI tools, agents, and connectors used across R&D. Working alongside senior team members, this role helps run the dedicated AI tools support function, assists with the service account and secrets lifecycle for AI connectors, and helps operate the internal AI hosting platform (PCA) — a great entry point into AIOps for someone who already thinks and works in an AI-tooling mindset and wants to build deep DevOps/infrastructure skills around it.

**What's in it for you?**

This is a chance to start your career at the center of PDC's AI transformation without needing to be a model builder. You'll learn to operate the infrastructure that every GenAI tool, agent, and connector at PDC depends on, working directly with senior engineers, AI-Infra, GIS, and R&D stakeholders to close real, currently unowned gaps. You'll build hands-on skills in an emerging space — AI connector/MCP operations, agentic tooling, and internal AI platform hosting — growing your DevOps/infrastructure foundation while applying AI tools you already use day to day.

**Our Group:**

Global DevOps Support is the team responsible for keeping PDC's R&D infrastructure — on-prem and cloud — reliable, secure, and supportable. As part of the broader AIOps effort to define clear roles and responsibilities across PDC's GenAI initiatives, the group has taken ownership of the operational layer of the AIOps platform: the AI tools support function, service account and secrets management for AI connectors, and the PCA hosting platform. You'll work closely with senior team members, AI-Infra, GIS, and R&D teams across PDC's Israel and Bangalore sites, with mentorship built into the role.

**What you'll be doing:**

* **Support AI Tools Support Operations:** Help staff and operate the dedicated support channel for GenAI tools, agents, and connectors — handling first-line triage against defined SLAs, maintaining the known-issue tracker, escalating to senior engineers or R&D when needed, and helping keep FAQs and runbooks up to date.

* **Assist with Service Accounts & Secrets:** Execute day-to-day provisioning, rotation, and audit tasks for service accounts and API keys used by AI connectors, agents, and utilities, following the established least-privilege and rotation policy under senior guidance.

* **Help Operate the PCA Hosting Platform:** Carry out routine access requests (firewall/URL approvals, non-VDI upload permissions) and auto-cleanup tasks on PDC's internal AI app hosting store, with senior support for cost tagging/chargeback and connector enablement work.

* **Support CI/CD & Indexing Pipelines:** Help keep the CI/CD and indexing pipelines that support AI tooling running — including embed/index pipelines (e.g., ChunkHound) and per-agent/app observability (invocations, latency, errors, token spend).

* **Apply Standards & Governance:** Follow the Utility Deployment Standards (4-Tier Supportable Funnel) and agent runbooks/BKMs so new AI tools and agents are onboarded consistently, and operate under the Cross-Org R&R Charter once finalized.

* **Contribute to Adoption Health Reporting:** Help compile regular reporting on ticket volume, resolution rate, and support-path coverage, making AI tooling adoption and reliability visible to stakeholders.

**What Should You Have?**

* A genuine AI mindset: working understanding of core GenAI concepts (what an LLM, prompt, agent, and connector/MCP actually are) and daily hands-on comfort using AI tools (Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as a user.

* Basic infrastructure fundamentals as a must: Linux basics (plus basic Windows administration), scripting basics (Python/Bash), and basic cloud/networking concepts.

* Working familiarity with CI/CD tooling (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar) — has used these tools, not necessarily built pipelines from scratch.

* Familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG, or AI agent design concepts.

* Hands-on experience with any enterprise GenAI platform (Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Claude/Anthropic, Vertex AI, or similar).

* Working familiarity with containers (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) — conceptual understanding and basic hands-on use.

* Basic understanding of cloud IAM and networking concepts (roles, access requests, firewall approvals) — independent configuration is not expected; you'll work under senior guidance.

* Understanding of secrets/key management concepts (what a vault, rotation policy, and access audit are for) — hands-on ownership is not expected; you'll execute established workflows under supervision.

* Ability to follow and execute defined service account/API key provisioning steps accurately and securely.

* Basic exposure to monitoring/observability and centralized logging tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Dynatrace, or equivalent) — has read dashboards, not necessarily built them.

* Comfort working within a ticketing/ITSM system, handling first-line triage and escalation per a defined SLA.

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to help write clear runbooks, BKMs, and FAQs for both technical and non-technical users.

* Comfort working in Agile/Scrum teams.

* Fast learner, comfortable asking questions and escalating — this role grows quickly from execution into ownership.

* 1–3 years of DevOps, IT, or infrastructure support experience (including internship/junior roles).

**What Gives You an Advantage?**

* Familiarity with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible).

* Exposure to artifact and container registry tools (e.g., JFrog Artifactory).

* Scripting exposure to Groovy, in addition to Python/Bash.

* Hands-on experience with secrets/key management tooling (Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault, or equivalent).

* Experience designing or operating service account/API key provisioning workflows end to end.

* Hands-on cloud IAM/networking configuration experience (Azure/AWS: service principals, roles, network egress, firewall/access configuration).

* Exposure to AI governance/compliance practices (audit logging policy, data classification, GDPR/IP review processes).

* Experience operating an internal developer platform, app store, or similar internal hosting platform (PaaS).

* Experience with dedicated AIOps or incident-automation tooling (Moogsoft, BigPanda, ServiceNow ITOM, or similar).

* Cloud or Kubernetes certifications (AWS, Azure, CKA).

* Prior experience in the semiconductor or broader technology industry.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role Summary**  
We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect - Data to provide architectural leadership across enterprise data, reporting, and analytics initiatives. The role will define scalable solutions across data platforms, integration services, semantic models, and business intelligence while ensuring security, governance, performance, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end solution and data architecture, including target-state designs, conceptual and logical data models, integration patterns, data flows, security controls, lineage, and technology standards.

* Define scalable engineering and integration patterns across Snowflake, cloud platforms, APIs, batch processing, and event-driven services, balancing resilience, performance, security, and cost.
* Own reporting and analytics architecture, including Performance Reporting, Client Reporting, Power BI, and semantic models. Establish standards for Import, DirectQuery, hybrid models, aggregation, incremental refresh, caching, and query optimization.
* Lead resolution of complex performance issues across source systems, data platforms, transformations, calculation layers, semantic models, and Power BI.
* Define measurable non-functional requirements for performance, scalability, availability, resilience, data freshness, observability, security, supportability, and cost.
* Establish reusable patterns for data modeling, metadata, lineage, data quality, auditability, governance, and access control to reduce technical debt.
* Provide architectural leadership across client, account, product, legal agreement, performance, benchmark, reference, and other strategic data domains.
* Act as a senior design authority by reviewing solutions, challenging technical choices, identifying risks and dependencies, mentoring teams, and communicating decisions to business and technology stakeholders.
* Maintain concise architecture deliverables, including diagrams, data models, integration flows, architecture decisions, deployment views, and operational-readiness documentation.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms and data-driven applications.
* Deep expertise in Snowflake, data warehousing, relational and dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT, metadata, lineage, data quality, and audit controls.
* Strong experience with Power BI architecture, semantic models, DAX, Import and DirectQuery patterns, incremental refresh, aggregation, and performance optimization.
* Experience diagnosing performance across SQL, transformation, semantic, and visualization layers.
* Experience with cloud architecture, APIs, services, batch and event-driven integration, security, observability, and operational resilience.
* Proven ability to define target-state architecture, reusable technical patterns, roadmaps, and measurable non-functional requirements.
* Strong technical leadership, stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Technical Skills**

* **Data & Analytics:** Snowflake, advanced SQL, Power BI, semantic modeling, DAX, ETL/ELT, data warehousing, data modeling, performance optimization, metadata, lineage, and data quality.
* **Cloud & Integration:** Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architecture, REST APIs, microservices, batch and event-driven integration, security, Key Vault/secrets management, observability, and resiliency patterns.
* **Application Engineering:** Python, FastAPI or similar service frameworks, React, TypeScript/JavaScript, and modern application architecture patterns.
* **Architecture & Governance:** Solution and data architecture, architecture lifecycle governance including Permit to Design, Permit to Build, and Permit to Operate, non-functional requirements, security architecture, operational readiness, and architecture decision records.
* **Engineering Practices:** CI/CD, DevSecOps, source control, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code concepts, production supportability, and performance monitoring.
* **Leadership:** Architecture reviews, design authority, technical roadmaps, mentoring, stakeholder communication, and collaboration across engineering, security, infrastructure, data governance, and enterprise architecture teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Investment management, asset management, financial services, or another highly governed data environment.
* Performance and client reporting, benchmark and reference data, account and client hierarchies, and legal-entity or agreement data.
* Modernization of legacy reporting and analytics solutions, architecture governance, data catalogs, business glossaries, and regulatory reporting.
* Applied knowledge of machine learning, artificial intelligence, and modern analytics within established security and governance standards.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

* Knowledge of system architecture, performance monitoring, tuning, and capacity management methodologies and tools.
* Experience in scripting using Bash, Python, or similar scripting languages.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description:
**Transform 800,000 hectares of greenhouses into fully-autonomous food production sites**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

At eternal.ag, we're building the future of sustainable food production. Our mission is to convert the world's existing greenhouses into fully automated facilities that can produce fresh food year-round - addressing the critical need to double food production by 2050 while facing severe labor shortages, water scarcity, and climate challenges.

**About the Role**
------------------

Help us bring our robots to life in greenhouses around the world. Whether you're a recent graduate or an experienced engineer, you'll build perception systems that enable robots to identify ripe produce, detect plant diseases, and navigate complex greenhouse environments autonomously.

As a Computer Vision Engineer at eternal.ag, you'll be part of a high-performance culture that values first-principles thinking and rapid iteration. You'll work at the intersection of classical computer vision and modern deep learning, creating perception systems that operate reliably in challenging agricultural environments with varying lighting, occlusions, and organic variability.

You'll collaborate with a distributed team across our Cologne HQ and Bengaluru office, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in agricultural computer vision while delivering practical solutions that work 24/7 in production environments.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Maintain and improve our perception pipeline**, including detecting ripe tomatoes among dense foliage, estimating cut points on stems with sub-centimeter accuracy, and adapting to new crop types as we expand.
* **Build and maintain data and model lifecycle infrastructure**, from data collection and annotation to model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining across our growing robot fleet.

* **Create real-time perception pipelines** that process 2D/3D sensor data for robotic decision-making with sub-centimeter accuracy.
* **Optimize vision algorithms** for edge deployment on robotic platforms, balancing accuracy with computational efficiency.
* **Build tools** for debugging, analysis, and performance evaluation of your algorithms. Root-cause failures when things break in production.
* **Collaborate cross-functionally** with robotics engineers, AI/ML researchers, and crop scientists to deliver end-to-end perception solutions.
* **You own your projects** from prototype to production. We expect production-quality software engineering, not just notebook experiments. We don't have separate research and engineering teams

**Who You Are**
---------------

#### **Core requirements (All levels)**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field (or graduating by Summer 2026)
* Strong programming skills in C++ and/or Python
* Solid understanding of deep learning fundamentals (training, evaluation, common failure modes) and how to apply them to real-world problems
* Understanding of 3D geometry, camera models, and coordinate transforms
* Working knowledge of classical CV (OpenCV, image processing, filtering)
* Experience with at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch preferred)
* Familiarity with Linux environments and version control systems
* A bias toward letting data and learning solve problems, while being pragmatic about when classical approaches are the right tool

#### **Experience levels**

**New Graduate / Entry Level (0-2 years)**

* Recent graduate or final year student with strong academic performance
* Hands-on computer vision and/or deep learning experience through internships, research projects, or competitions (Kaggle, university labs, personal projects)
* Demonstrated programming skills through coursework or personal projects
* Understands model training and evaluation basics, including common failure modes

**Early Career (2-5 years)**

* Has built a training pipeline end-to-end: data collection/curation, training, evaluation, deployment, and iteration based on real-world feedback
* Experience taking at least one vision or ML system from prototype to production
* Proficiency with modern architectures (YOLO, Mask R-CNN, Vision Transformers)
* Can make sound tradeoffs between classical and learning-based components in a perception pipeline
* Practical experience with model optimization for edge deployment (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX export)

**Senior Level (5-8 years)**

* Proven track record of deploying production perception systems and making sound architectural tradeoffs between classical and learning-based approaches
* Experience designing data strategies: what to collect, how to annotate efficiently, when to retrain vs. fine-tune
* MLOps experience: automated retraining pipelines, model versioning, drift detection, or A/B evaluation across a deployed fleet
* Knowledge of model optimization for embedded systems (quantization, pruning, distillation)
* Ability to mentor junior engineers and make technical decisions that compound over time

**Staff/Principal Level (8+ years)**

* Technical leadership experience with complex perception systems at scale
* Has built and iterated on the full ML lifecycle: training infrastructure, data flywheels, MLOps, model monitoring, continuous improvement at fleet scale
* Strategic thinking about perception architecture, including when learned methods outperform engineered solutions and when simpler methods remain preferable
* Track record of building and scaling high-performance computer vision teams

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with foundation models, vision-language models, or transfer learning for domain adaptation
* Knowledge of 3D sensors (stereo cameras, depth sensors)
* Familiarity with ROS2 for perception system integration
* Experience with MLOps and ML infrastructure: experiment tracking, model versioning, automated retraining, data management at scale
* Publications at top-tier computer vision or ML conferences (CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML)
* Open source contributions to computer vision or ML projects

**Why eternal.ag?**
-------------------

**Launch Your Career**: For new graduates, this is a unique opportunity to join a proven team and learn from engineers who've already built and deployed commercial vision systems. You'll get hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology while making a real-world impact from day one.

**Impact at Scale**: Your perception algorithms will directly enable robots to transform 800,000 hectares of greenhouses worldwide into sustainable, autonomous food production facilities.

**Technical Excellence**: Work with state-of-the-art computer vision technology including modern deep learning architectures, 3D perception, and multi-modal sensor fusion.

**Rapid Innovation**: Our software-first approach means you'll see your models deployed to real robots in hours/days, not months. We've proven we can develop and deploy new perception capabilities over-the-air as crops evolve.

**Unique Challenges**: Tackle perception problems that combine the complexity of outdoor vision (varying lighting, weather) with the precision requirements of industrial automation.

**Growth Opportunity**: Join as we scale from proof-of-concept to global deployment. Be part of the core team shaping the future of agricultural perception. Clear career progression from graduate to senior engineer and beyond.

**Mentorship & Learning**: Work alongside experienced computer vision engineers who've solved complex real-world problems. We invest in your growth through hands-on projects, technical mentorship, and exposure to all aspects of vision system development.

**Flexible Work Culture**: Distributed team with offices in Cologne and Bengaluru, following a "follow-the-sun" support model for our 24/7 operations.

**Our Tech Stack**
------------------

* **Deep Learning:** PyTorch, ONNX
* **Deployment**: TensorRT, ONNX Runtime
* **Vision** **& 3D**: OpenCV
* **Sensors**: RGB cameras, stereo vision, depth sensors
* **Data & Training:** Cloud-native training pipelines, experiment tracking, annotation tooling
* **Infrastructure**: Edge deployment systems, OTA model updates
* **Integration**: ROS2 for robotic system integration

**Apply Now**
-------------

Ready to revolutionize how the world grows food through advanced computer vision? Whether you're starting your career or looking to make a bigger impact, join us in building perception systems that will enable sustainable food production for billions.

We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experience levels who are excited about our mission and show potential to grow with us. Recent graduates - don't let experience requirements hold you back; we value passion, potential, and fresh perspectives.

*eternal.ag* *is building fully automated food production sites that can sustainably produce fresh food year-round. Backed by world-class investors and partnering with leading agricultural companies, we're turning the vision of fully-autonomous greenhouses into reality.*

description:

So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? **Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next.”**

In a world where you can be anything, **Be Infoblox.**

**Director, Cloud Delivery Assurance**

**The Opportunity**

We have an opportunity for a **Director, Cloud Delivery Assurance** to build and lead our new Cloud Delivery Assurance team within SaaS Platform Engineering in Pune or Bangalore, India, reporting to the VP, Engineering.

In this pivotal role, you will make release readiness a defensible, engineering-owned decision. You will establish a team of automation and delivery-assurance engineers, define the roadmap from manual and inconsistent release checks to an automated artifact-promotion pipeline, and own the quality gates that govern promotion of SaaS software from development clusters through integration and staging environments into production.

Collaborating closely with Solutions QA, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, CloudOps, application, and platform teams, you will create the integration-quality, automation, and production-readiness operating model that validates the combined system before customers experience it. You will establish trusted environments, shared tooling, and evidence-based release-readiness gates while complementing—not duplicating—the charters of Solutions QA, DevOps, and SRE.

You are the ideal candidate if you have built quality or delivery-assurance organizations from the ground up, are fluent in Kubernetes-based cloud platforms and CI/CD, and are comfortable making clear, data-backed decisions when the evidence does not support a release.

**Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do**

* Build the CDA strategy, roadmap, operating model, and staffing plan; align scope, milestones, investment, and success measures with the SVP, Platform Engineering and peer engineering leaders
* Hire, lead, coach, and develop a team of one technical project manager and eight software development engineers in test; establish the team charter, operating cadence, engineering standards, and inclusive culture
* Own the automated artifact-promotion pipeline from CI build and security-scan validation through development-cluster smoke testing, integration and certification runs, staging certification, and production promotion
* Define, implement, and enforce quality gates for each promotion decision, including entry and exit criteria, required evidence, hold-and-return behavior, risk acceptance, and rollback expectations
* Serve as the accountable approver for promotion of SaaS software across development, integration, staging, and production environments; make go/no-go recommendations defensible with data
* Establish a common test-automation framework, shared libraries, and fit-for-purpose test environments for API, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and deployment-verification testing
* Apply AI-assisted engineering tools, including code assistants, test-generation capabilities, and intelligent analytics, to improve productivity, expand meaningful test coverage, identify risk patterns, and support—not replace—engineering judgment
* Govern responsible use of AI-generated code and test assets through human review, security and privacy controls, traceability, and measurable quality outcomes
* Deliver readiness scorecards, quality and risk heatmaps, coverage and escape-rate metrics, defect trends, mean-time-to-detect measures, and environment and release status for engineering leadership
* Partner with Solutions QA on end-to-end functional coverage and release sign-off, and with SRE on stress, scale, high availability, disaster recovery, and chaos testing

**Be Prepared — What You Bring**

* Fifteen or more years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, test automation, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or delivery assurance, including five or more years leading and growing engineering or QA teams
* Proven success defining and delivering quality, automation, and release-readiness strategies for cloud-native SaaS platforms
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes, Linux, containers, public cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, distributed systems, and microservices
* Strong command of CI/CD practices, including pipeline design, artifact promotion, progressive delivery, canary releases, deployment verification, and automated quality gates using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Argo, or Spinnaker
* Expertise in test-automation architecture across API, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and production-readiness testing, with the technical depth to review designs and code
* Experience building metrics-driven programs using measures such as coverage, escape rate, defect trends, mean time to detect, release risk, and environment stability
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development, test-generation, analytics, automation, content-generation, or decision-support tools, with an understanding of responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across QA, SRE, DevOps, product, application, and platform teams while maintaining a consistent quality bar under delivery pressure
* Experience hiring and scaling engineering teams in India, preferably across distributed or multi-site environments, and building an inclusive, high-accountability culture
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; a master’s degree is a plus

**Be Successful — Your Path**

**First 90 Days:** Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors through Blox Buddies, and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long-term goals.

**Six Months:**

* Operate automated build and development-cluster validation gates for every release candidate, with promotion decisions recorded and evidence collected automatically
* Establish the common test-automation framework and shared libraries, with regression suites running on a predictable schedule against a protected certification baseline
* Launch readiness scorecards and quality-risk reporting, including AI-assisted aggregation and analysis of release evidence with human review and clear auditability
* Complete staffing and onboarding for the CDA team, with the technical project manager driving milestones, dependencies, and stakeholder communications
* Define baseline measures for coverage, escape rate, defect trends, environment stability, and release-cycle efficiency; use the data to prioritize improvements

**One Year:**

* Establish CDA as the mandatory release-readiness gate for the SaaS platform, with staging certification and production-promotion decisions consistently supported by objective evidence
* Automate critical regression coverage for release candidates and demonstrate measurable improvement in customer-found defects and release-time Sev 1 and Sev 2 incidents
* Validate Tier 1 services for high availability, scale, performance, recovery, and deployment safety in partnership with SRE
* Integrate AI-assisted test development and release analytics into the operating model with appropriate security, privacy, governance, and human-review controls
* Establish a smooth interlock among CDA, Solutions QA, SRE, DevOps, CloudOps, application, and platform teams, with remediation routed and closed through a single visible workflow

**Belong —** **Your Community**

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

**Be Rewarded —** **Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong**

* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
* Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks, plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
* Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

**Ready to Be the Difference?**

================================================

**Location:** Bangalore, India

**About nference**
------------------

nference is an AI-powered technology company transforming biomedical research by leveraging large-scale data, advanced machine learning, and deep scientific expertise. Our mission is to accelerate breakthroughs in healthcare and life sciences by building innovative products that help researchers and clinicians solve complex real-world problems.

**Our People**
--------------

At nference, you'll work alongside software engineers, AI researchers, physicians, scientists, and product leaders who are passionate about solving meaningful, real-world problems.

We foster a culture of ownership, curiosity, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous learning. Our teams are encouraged to challenge assumptions, contribute ideas, and take ownership of their work from problem definition through implementation.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We're looking for a **Consultant - Junior Clinical Research Doctor** with an MBBS degree and a strong interest in clinical research, healthcare technology, and AI-driven product development.

In this role, you will work closely with AI, Data Science, and Engineering teams to develop software that interprets electronic health records (EHRs) and supports biomedical research. You will apply your clinical knowledge to healthcare data curation, clinical validation, and the development of clinically sound product requirements.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of medicine and patient care, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to translate clinical concepts into structured data and meaningful technical requirements.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Collaborate with AI, Data Science, and Engineering teams to develop software for interpreting electronic health records and other healthcare data.
* Review and annotate clinical datasets with a high degree of accuracy to support AI model development and evaluation.
* Review patient notes and EHR records to provide clinical context and insights where required.
* Harmonize laboratory data and clinical or biomedical concepts to improve consistency and usability across datasets.

* Curate and validate medical concepts, including diagnoses, procedures, investigations, medications, and laboratory observations.
* Develop clinically sound and scientifically relevant technical user stories using existing applications and products under development.
* Apply clinical knowledge to identify inconsistencies, ambiguities, and data quality issues in healthcare datasets.
* Support clinical validation of datasets, data mappings, and AI-generated outputs where applicable.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to clarify clinical requirements and translate them into structured product and technical specifications.
* Document clinical definitions, data interpretation guidelines, and validation findings to support consistency and reproducibility.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* **MBBS degree from a reputed medical institution in India is mandatory.**
* Strong understanding of clinical medicine, patient care, and medical terminology.
* Strong interest in clinical research, healthcare technology, and AI-driven product development.
* Ability to interpret clinical information and apply medical knowledge to healthcare datasets.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail when reviewing, annotating, and validating clinical information.
* Ability to communicate clinical concepts clearly and collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.
* Good written documentation and organizational skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Understanding of electronic health records and clinical data within the **US healthcare system**.
* Familiarity with medical coding systems for diagnoses, procedures, investigations, and medications.
* Exposure to clinical data curation, medical annotation, or healthcare data standardization.
* Familiarity with laboratory data, clinical terminologies, and common healthcare data models.
* Interest in AI, machine learning, and the application of technology to clinical research.
* Experience participating in clinical research, academic projects, or healthcare product development.

**Why Join nference?**
----------------------

* **Healthcare Innovation:** Contribute to AI-powered technologies that support biomedical research and healthcare innovation.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with AI researchers, engineers, data scientists, and clinical experts.
* **Meaningful Impact:** Apply your medical knowledge to real-world healthcare data and product development challenges.
* **Learning & Growth:** Gain exposure to clinical informatics, healthcare data standardization, and AI applications in medicine.
* **Research-Driven Environment:** Contribute to products designed to help researchers and clinicians derive insights from complex healthcare data.

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* **Industry Prestige:** Build your career at an AI-first healthcare technology company working at the intersection of AI, software engineering, and biomedical research.
* **Cutting-Edge Innovation:** Work with complex clinical, biomedical, and unstructured healthcare data.
* **Meaningful Impact:** Contribute to technologies that accelerate biomedical research and improve healthcare outcomes.
* **Growth & Flexibility:** Work in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment with continuous learning opportunities and a hybrid work model for eligible consultants, subject to company policy and applicable terms.
* **Wellness & Perks:** Benefits and reimbursements, where applicable, are provided in accordance with company policies and the terms of engagement.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

nference is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. **The Opportunity**

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our engineering team in Bangalore, India. In this role, you will drive the architecture, design, and development of large-scale ad serving, measurement, targeting, and data engineering systems that power LG Ad Solutions’ global advertising platform.

As a senior technical leader, you will own critical technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams, establish architectural direction, and drive the delivery of highly scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient distributed systems. You will work closely with engineering, product, and operations teams across geographies, providing technical leadership and collaborating with teams in the US and India to deliver high-impact solutions.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an engineer who combines deep software engineering expertise with strong architectural judgment, a track record of solving complex engineering problems, and the ability to influence technical decisions across teams. You will also mentor senior engineers, establish engineering best practices, and help shape the long-term technical roadmap of LG Ad Solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* **Technical Leadership and Architecture:** Define and drive the architecture of large-scale, distributed software systems, making critical technical decisions around scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability.
* **System Design and Scalability:** Design and evolve high-throughput ad serving, targeting, measurement, and data processing systems capable of handling large data volumes and demanding latency requirements.
* **End-to-End Technical Ownership:** Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from problem definition and requirements gathering through architecture, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* **Distributed Systems and Data Engineering:** Drive the design and optimization of big data applications and distributed computing platforms, improving processing efficiency, resource utilization, and infrastructure cost.
* **Technical Strategy and Roadmap:** Partner with engineering leadership and product teams to define technical strategy, identify architectural gaps, establish long-term roadmaps, and align engineering investments with business priorities.
* **Engineering Excellence:** Establish and champion best practices for software design, code quality, testing, observability, operational readiness, and production reliability.
* **Cross-Team Influence:** Collaborate across engineering teams and organizational boundaries to resolve complex technical challenges, align architectural decisions, and drive consistent engineering standards.
* **Mentorship and Technical Development:** Mentor senior and junior engineers, guide design and code reviews, and help develop technical leadership within the organization.
* **Performance and Reliability:** Identify and resolve system bottlenecks, improve service-level objectives, and lead initiatives that enhance throughput, latency, fault tolerance, and overall system resilience.
* **Platform Integrations:** Lead the design and implementation of integrations with internal and external platforms to expand advertising targeting, measurement, and data capabilities.
* **Global Collaboration:** Work closely with engineering teams in the US and India to drive successful project execution, share technical knowledge, and ensure alignment across distributed teams.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating large-scale, production-grade software systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading the architecture and delivery of complex, distributed systems with significant scale, throughput, reliability, or data processing requirements.
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Go, Scala, Python, Java, or C++, along with a deep understanding of computer science fundamentals.
* Extensive experience with distributed systems, concurrency, data structures, algorithms, system design, and performance optimization.
* Hands-on experience with big data technologies such as Apache Spark and Databricks, and data storage and caching technologies such as MySQL, Redis, or ElastiCache.
* Experience designing, deploying, and operating cloud-native systems using AWS, Kubernetes, and related infrastructure technologies.
* Ability to navigate, understand, and refactor large, complex codebases while maintaining high standards of reliability and maintainability.
* Strong understanding of system observability, production troubleshooting, fault tolerance, capacity planning, and cost optimization.
* Proven ability to make sound architectural trade-offs, evaluate alternative approaches, and influence technical decisions across multiple teams.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, guide technical discussions, and raise engineering standards across teams.
* Experience collaborating with globally distributed engineering teams and driving projects across geographical boundaries.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building and scaling ad tech platforms, including ad serving, audience targeting, advertising measurement, or real-time bidding systems.

* Experience designing high-throughput, low-latency services and large-scale data processing pipelines.

* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and drive alignment across engineering, product, and operations.

* Experience working in a global engineering organization with teams across India and the US.

title: Engineering Manager, Managed Gateways Infrastructure
description:
**Location**
------------

Bangalore, India; Bangalore, India

-------------------

**Department**

All Cost CenterR&DENG

  

**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

**The Mission**
---------------

Kong Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native **SaaS** platform, powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a **multi-tenant** control plane, automation, and platform services that let customers securely deploy, operate, and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service. Behind that experience sits a distributed platform responsible for provisioning, fleet management, software lifecycle, zero-downtime upgrades, observability, security, and multi-region operations across globally distributed cloud infrastructure - built to a target of 99.99% availability, balancing reliability, performance, operational excellence, and infrastructure efficiency at global **SaaS** scale.

As a Software Engineering Manager for Managed Gateways Infrastructure, you will own and grow Kong's Bangalore-based engineering team, taking full accountability for this **multi-tenant SaaS** platform. Kong Cloud Gateways is growing 100% YoY, and as enterprises increasingly adopt AI alongside traditional APIs, this platform becomes an increasingly important part of Kong's API and AI strategy - every improvement in automation, scalability, and operational excellence you drive accelerates new platform capabilities and lets product teams innovate faster. Beyond the technical charter, you play a key role in shaping a dynamic engineering culture - one built on urgency, ownership, and first-principles thinking - as the team scales to match the pace of the business.

This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role - you're expected to stay close to the systems, dig into hard problems alongside your team, and not hesitate to get into the trenches when it matters.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own and grow Kong's Managed Gateways Infrastructure engineering team in Bangalore - scaling the team's capability, raising the technical bar, and staying hands-on in critical implementations and incidents, not just directing from a distance.
* Own the reliability and scalability of a multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure platform serving customers across regions and clouds - every architectural decision has to hold up under multi-tenant load, isolation, and blast-radius considerations, not just single-tenant assumptions.
* **Drive 4-9s (99.99%+)** availability across Kong's global infrastructure footprint - owning capacity, resilience, and failure-mode design across multi-region, multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP) so Cloud Gateways stays up for customers everywhere, at any scale.
* Act as a direct technical contributor when it counts - complex incidents, architecture reviews, and high-stakes implementations that materially move the needle on Managed Gateways' growth and reliability.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team building and operating Kong's **SaaS** infrastructure for Managed Gateways, in direct support of our critical enterprise customer base globally.
* Architect and implement robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud-native systems using technologies like Kubernetes, Golang, and major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Own the complete operational lifecycle end-to-end - infrastructure, reliability, on-call, incident response, and blameless post-mortems - as one integrated engineering charter, not a separate function.
* Drive developer delight and operational efficiency through automation, self-service tooling, and streamlined workflows for deploying and managing API gateways, while proactively preventing technical debt and reducing operational toil.
* Define, track, and report on key SLOs and SLIs, and advocate for architectural best practices that keep Managed Gateways performant and resilient as it scales.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, engineering, and support teams to influence roadmap decisions and ensure operational readiness for new features.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

### **The Toolkit:**

* Proven experience leading and managing software engineering teams responsible for infrastructure and reliability in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with a track record of staying technically hands-on rather than purely delegating.
* Deep, current expertise in designing, deploying, and operating highly available distributed systems on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - this role needs someone who can still open a terminal and debug production, not just review architecture diagrams.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s) and container orchestration in production environments.
* Proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for infrastructure automation and service development.
* Strong understanding of observability principles and experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar.
* Demonstrated ability to manage critical incidents personally when needed, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective preventative measures.
* Familiarity with API gateway technologies, service mesh, or network proxies is a significant plus.

### **The Kong DNA:**

* **Ownership:** You take full responsibility for the reliability and performance of systems, driving initiatives from conception to completion.
* **Urgency:** You thrive in dynamic environments, prioritizing critical issues and delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision.
* **Collaboration:** You build strong relationships, foster open communication, and work effectively across global teams to achieve shared goals.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience with open-source contributions or active participation in SRE/cloud-native communities.
* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (e.g., CKA, CKAD).
* Background in companies focused on developer tools, infrastructure software, or API management.

**About Kong:**

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.
