**Job Description (JD) – Research Engineer / Senior Research Engineer, Audio AI**
=================================================================================

**Position Details**
--------------------

**Job Title:** Research Engineer / Senior Research Engineer – Audio AI
  
**Location:** Bangalore, India
  
**Experience:** 2 - 5 Years
  
**Joining:** Immediate

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking a highly motivated **Research Engineer / Senior Research Engineer – Audio AI** to join our AI research and product development team. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in **Audio Machine Learning (ML), Deep Learning (DL), Speech Processing, and Audio AI Model Development**.

The role involves designing, developing, training, fine-tuning, and optimizing Audio AI models for real-world product applications. The candidate will work on speech and audio technologies including **Wake Word Detection, Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Voice Activity Detection (VAD), Acoustic Modeling, Audio Denoising, and Noise Analysis** while leveraging modern deep learning architectures such as **CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, Large Audio Models, and Large Language Models (LLMs).**

The candidate should be capable of implementing research papers, developing models from scratch, optimizing model performance, and supporting deployment on product and edge-device environments.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Audio AI Research & Development**

* Design, develop, train, and fine-tune Audio ML/DL models based on product requirements.
* Build Audio AI models from scratch for new product use cases.
* Study, implement, and evaluate state-of-the-art research papers.
* Apply transfer learning techniques to improve model performance.
* Optimize models for accuracy, latency, memory utilization, and runtime efficiency.
* Perform model benchmarking, performance validation, and comparative analysis.

### **Speech & Audio Intelligence**

* Develop and optimize solutions for:
  + Wake Word Detection
  + Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
  + Voice Activity Detection (VAD)
  + Acoustic Modeling
  + Noise Analysis
  + Audio Denoising
* Analyze audio data characteristics, waveform behavior, and signal quality.
* Develop audio preprocessing and feature extraction pipelines.
* Implement noise augmentation and audio mixing techniques.

### **Transformer Models & LLMs**

* Train, fine-tune, and optimize transformer-based architectures.
* Fine-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) for audio and speech-related applications.
* Improve transformer and LLM performance in terms of:
  + Accuracy
  + Latency
  + Runtime efficiency
  + Resource utilization

### **Edge AI & Deployment**

* Optimize Audio AI models for deployment on edge and embedded devices.
* Support model integration into production environments.
* Work with software and embedded teams to ensure successful deployment.
* Implement model compression and optimization techniques for resource-constrained systems.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with AI researchers, software engineers, embedded teams, and product stakeholders.
* Convert research concepts into scalable product-level solutions.
* Support system integration, troubleshooting, and production validation activities.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

### **Audio AI & Speech Processing**

* Strong experience in Audio AI model development and optimization.
* Hands-on experience in Audio Machine Learning and Deep Learning.
* Experience building Audio AI models from scratch.
* Strong understanding of:
  + Audio Preprocessing
  + Audio Feature Extraction
  + Audio Signal Analysis
  + Speech Processing
  + Waveform Analysis
* Experience in:
  + Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
  + Voice Activity Detection (VAD)
  + Wake Word Detection
  + Acoustic Modeling
  + Audio Denoising
  + Noise Analysis

### **Machine Learning & Deep Learning**

Strong hands-on experience with:

**Frameworks**

* PyTorch
* TensorFlow
* Keras

**Deep Learning Architectures**

* CNN and Variants
* RNN
* LSTM
* GRU
* Attention Mechanisms
* Transformers
* Large Audio Models

### **Large Audio Models**

Hands-on experience with:

* wav2vec
* Whisper
* Other modern speech/audio foundation models

### **Signal Processing**

Strong fundamentals in:

* Digital Signal Processing (DSP)
* Audio Signal Processing
* Time-Domain Analysis
* Frequency-Domain Analysis
* Spectral Processing
* Audio Feature Engineering
* Noise Analysis & Denoising

title: AI Operating System (AIOS) Leader
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
About Lilly
  
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
About Technology@Lilly
  
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Bengaluru builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  
Role Summary
  
The AI Operating System (AIOS) Leader owns the strategy, architecture, and delivery of Lilly's AI Operating System — a connected, four-layer ecosystem (Data, Compute, Model, and Application) built on platforms including LillyCode, LillyPod, Weights & Biases, the LLM Gateway, and BioNova. This role leads the ML Engineering and Data Engineering teams that build and operate AIOS, combining deep technical credibility with people leadership to remove friction, eliminate duplicated work, and give every data scientist and research team at Lilly a faster path from idea to impact.
  
The AIOS Leader is accountable for advancing AIOS through its roadmap phases: from the Phase 1 foundation (LillyCode, LillyPod, the LLM Gateway, and core data infrastructure), through Phase 2 ML lifecycle maturity (production experiment tracking, model registry, and marketplace expansion), to Phase 3 R&D AI at scale (multi-modal AI and shared infrastructure enabling scientific breakthroughs). The role is the central point of accountability connecting engineering, science, and enterprise architecture, ensuring AIOS and the Enterprise Stack remain complementary rather than competing investments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* AIOS Strategy & Roadmap Ownership:

Set and own the strategy, architecture, and phased roadmap for the AI Operating System — from Phase 1 Foundation through Phase 2 ML Lifecycle to Phase 3 R&D AI at Scale — ensuring each layer of the stack (Data, Compute, Model, Application) advances against committed timelines.
  

* Team Leadership & Talent Development:

Lead, mentor, and grow the ML Engineering and Data Engineering teams, including matrixed specialists embedded with science squads through the ML Engineering Chapter; build a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and continuous learning.
  

* AIOS Platform Ownership:

Own delivery and continuous improvement of core AIOS platforms — LillyCode (AI-assisted development), LillyPod (on-prem GPU compute), the LLM Gateway (governed frontier model access), Weights & Biases (ML lifecycle management), Weka Fabric (high-performance storage), and BioNova (Scientific Desktop) — ensuring each meets scale, security, and reliability requirements.
  
  

* Cross-Stack Partnership:

Partner with Enterprise Stack leadership (Cortex, Landing Zone, CATS/Hangar) to ensure AIOS and the Enterprise Stack remain complementary, with models built in AIOS flowing into enterprise agentic workflows and business requirements flowing back.
  

* Compute & Infrastructure Stewardship:

Govern shared, self-service access to compute and storage (GPU scheduling via Run: ai, high-performance storage via Weka Fabric) across all Lilly scientific teams, balancing guaranteed quotas, over-quota bursting, and fair prioritization.
  

* Science Enablement:

Work directly with research and science squads (e.g., genomic AI and pharmacogenomics teams) to apply AIOS capabilities to high-value problems, translating scientific compute and data needs into platform requirements.
  
  

* Governance & Security:

Ensure AIOS platforms complete cybersecurity review and AI Registry registration, with data-residency safeguards, usage tracking, and cost attribution across models and compute — including in regulated (e.g., GxP) environments.
  
  

* Executive Communication & Advocacy:

Represent AIOS to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, articulating impact (e.g., active users, tokens processed, digital worker equivalents, time-to-insight) and building the case for continued investment.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with 12+ years of relevant experience
* Proven experience owning a multi-layer AI/ML platform (data, compute, model, and application layers) in a large, matrixed enterprise
* Demonstrated leadership of both ML Engineering and Data Engineering functions, including managing leads across multiple squads
* Deep knowledge of GPU compute infrastructure, distributed training, and high-performance storage (e.g., GPU scheduling, parallel file systems)
* Experience governing frontier model access (e.g., multi-provider LLM gateways) including usage tracking, cost attribution, and vendor-agnostic architecture
* Track record of delivering ML lifecycle tooling (experiment tracking, model registry, dataset versioning) at enterprise scale
* Experience operating in regulated environments (GxP, SOX, CSV/CSA) within life sciences or another regulated industry
* Strong executive presence with experience presenting technical strategy and roadmap to senior leadership
* Experience partnering with enterprise application or agent-platform teams to ensure complementary, non-duplicative investment across stacks

Core Competencies
  
Platform & Technical Strategy • Organizational Leadership • Cross-Functional Partnership • Compute & Infrastructure Governance • AI/ML Lifecycle Expertise • Executive Communication • Talent Development • Delivery at Scale
  
  
Additional Information
  
Up to 10% travel, including international.

If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

title: AI System Performance Architect
description:
**Job Details:**

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a talented and motivated AI System Performance Architect. The role owns the end-to-end understanding of AI training and inference systems, sitting where serving strategy, parallelism, collective communication, and interconnect behavior come together. Through analytical modelling and multi-GPU simulation, the candidate translates SLA and deployment targets into concrete architectural guidance for Intel's future AI platforms. Strong analytical skills and the ability to present performance findings and configuration recommendations to engineering and leadership teams are essential.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  

* Own end-to-end understanding of the AI training/inference system and build analytical models and multi-GPU simulation - including MPI/collective communication (allgather, allreduce, all-to-all) and interconnect contention - to project performance, expose architectural bottlenecks, and recommend optimal Intel system configurations.
* Model inferencing strategies - static batching, continuous batching, disaggregated serving, and chunked prefill - across frameworks such as vLLM and SGLang, covering agentic inferencing, prefix caching, and multi-turn flows.
* Cover data, pipeline, tensor, and expert parallelism and their communication patterns.
* Drive studies against SLA targets - batch size, TTFT, TPOT, ISL/OSL, and TPS.
* Analyse regression run traces and find patterns in utilization counters across SLA operating points to identify architectural bottlenecks.
* Perform what-if analysis by sweeping core count, memory/cache capacity and bandwidth, fabric bandwidth, GPU interconnect, and deployment options; deliver optimization and optimal architecture recommendations.
* Scout whitepapers, blogs, and conferences; keep self and team updated on AI innovations applicable to Intel's end-to-end system.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Required Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's, master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Bachelors with 8+ yrs, master’s with 6+ years and Ph.D. with 3+ years of experience in system performance modelling, AI workload analysis, or hardware architecture.
* Strong proficiency in Python, with the ability to build modular, maintainable analytical models and simulation frameworks.
* Solid understanding of LLM inference and training mechanics: prefill vs. decode, KV cache, batching policies, and quantization.
* Working knowledge of distributed parallelism strategies and their communication patterns.
* Familiarity with multi-GPU interconnect architectures (NVLink, PCIe, CXL, or equivalent).
* Understanding of SoC and platform fundamentals: core count scaling, cache/memory capacity and bandwidth, and fabric behavior.

  
**Good-to-Have Skills**  

* Experience building discrete-event simulators for multi-node or multi-accelerator systems.
* Familiarity with performance profiling tools (e.g., Intel VTune, NVIDIA Nsight, or similar).
* Prior experience in a semiconductor or hardware company working on AI accelerator or platform products.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a SIEM Content Development Specialist to contribute to the Cyber Security Operations Centre (CSOC) detection capability within Cyber Defence. Based in Pune or Bangalore, India, this individual contributor role focuses on translating business requirements, threat intelligence, the evolving threat landscape, MITRE TTPs and cyber risks into effective detection content.  
You will develop, tune and improve SIEM, EDR and XDR detection capabilities, with particular emphasis on Elastic Security/ELK, KQL, ES|QL and Regex. The role requires at least 6 years of relevant experience across areas such as Security Operations, SIEM content development, security engineering, threat hunting or threat intelligence.  
You will operate with limited supervision, make informed technical decisions and collaborate with stakeholders across the security community.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

Develop and enhance detection content across existing and new SIEM, EDR and XDR technologies.  
Create threat scenarios and SIEM detection rules/use cases, particularly within Elastic Security/ELK and ArcSight environments.  
Tune detection rules and correlation logic to improve CSOC efficiency, detection quality and risk reduction.  
Analyse adversaries, attack techniques and tools to create indicator-based and behavioural detections.  
Map security detections to MITRE ATT&CK TTPs, cyber kill chain concepts and relevant APT campaign strategies.  
Collaborate with log-source owners and customers to understand telemetry, security requirements and use cases, translating them into actionable detection content.  
Contribute to and potentially lead threat-response workflows and playbook development and integration.  
Apply software engineering, SDLC and Agile practices to security content engineering initiatives.  
Develop security content using technologies and languages including Python, SQL, JavaScript, PowerShell, KQL and ES|QL, as appropriate.  
Develop and maintain Regex patterns supporting security analytics and detection.  
Analyse security events and identify potential threats that could evade existing custom or out-of-the-box detections.  
Contribute to cyber security reports and advisories for relevant stakeholders.  
Perform post-incident analysis and translate lessons learnt and residual risks into actionable improvements.  
Create and maintain documentation, including detection-development workflows and playbooks.  
Continuously improve the SOC use-case framework and the effectiveness of detection and response capabilities.  
Prioritise concurrent activities and deliver work within agreed deadlines.  
Contribute technical leadership to security content projects where required.

**Who you are**
---------------

6+ years of experience in Security Operations (SOC), SIEM content development, security engineering, threat hunting and/or threat intelligence.  
Practical experience with SDLC frameworks and Agile methodologies.  
Strong working knowledge of Elastic Security/ELK, including Elastic, Logstash and Kibana.  
Understanding of other SIEM platforms such as ArcSight, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Chronicle and cloud-native SIEM technologies.  
Experience developing threat scenarios and SIEM detection rules/use cases, preferably using ArcSight and Elastic/ELK.  
Knowledge of cloud and security telemetry across AWS, GCP and Microsoft technologies, including EDR, Log Analytics and Azure, as well as Oracle environments.  
Software engineering or development experience and an understanding of data structures and algorithms.  
Expertise in one or more relevant languages or technologies, such as Python, SQL, JavaScript, PowerShell, KQL or ES|QL.  
Strong practical knowledge of regular expressions (Regex).  
In-depth knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, cyber kill chain concepts, APT campaigns, security threats and vulnerabilities.  
Hands-on experience analysing security events, refining SIEM content and improving detection efficiency.  
Knowledge of cyber-risk analysis, management and security-reporting frameworks.  
Deep understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, CIDR, subnetting, addressing and network communications.  
Knowledge of security technologies including firewalls, intrusion-detection systems, antivirus systems, anti-spam technologies, event-correlation platforms and log-analysis tools.  
Understanding of security-tool architecture and design, including technologies used to identify advanced threats.  
Strong analytical, stakeholder communication, prioritisation and time-management skills.  
A degree in Information Technology, Engineering or a similar discipline.  
Prior or current information security or advanced networking certifications, including qualifications such as CISSP, GCIH or GCIA.

Work on cyber defence and detection capabilities that protect Vodafone customers against global cyber risk.  
Gain exposure to enterprise-scale SIEM, EDR and XDR technologies in a Cyber Security Operations Centre environment.  
Work across multiple detection technologies, cloud environments, telemetry sources and security use cases.  
Collaborate with log-source owners, customers and security stakeholders across the Vodafone security community.  
Contribute to projects spanning detection engineering, threat response, threat hunting, cyber-risk reduction and security automation.  
Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the direction of security content engineering projects.

**What skills you will learn**

Advanced SIEM detection and security content engineering.  
Elastic Security/ELK, KQL, ES|QL and Regex.  
EDR/XDR detection development and operational tuning.  
MITRE ATT&CK-aligned detection engineering and threat modelling.  
Behavioural and indicator-based detection methodologies.  
Threat hunting and analysis of adversary techniques and attack tools.  
Security use-case design across cloud and enterprise telemetry.  
Threat-response playbook and workflow development.  
Applying SDLC and Agile methodologies to detection engineering.

title: Senior Engineer, AI Security
description:
The **AI Security Engineer** is responsible for building and running the security controls that find and govern the use of artificial intelligence across Danaher, including chat tools, AI platforms, and autonomous agents. The engineer configures and tunes policies and detections in CrowdStrike Falcon and AI gateways, and builds the automation that lets Danaher adopt AI safely.

This position reports to the **Senior Manager, AI Security & Governance** and is part of the **DIS Corporate Cybersecurity - AI Security** team located in **Bangalore or Pune India** and will be an on-site role.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Configure, tune, and maintain security policies for the AI control plane in CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (now Falcon Guardian) and Falcon Shield, including access rules, prompt rules, and report, transform, or block actions.
* Manage policy and configuration for AI gateways that cover gaps the CrowdStrike tools cannot reach.
* Build alerts and detections for unapproved AI use, risky agent behavior, and policy violations, aligned to the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications.
* Build the automation yourself: prove a task by hand in the platform, then automate it with Python, PowerShell, and platform APIs.
* Contribute to AI security design with the AI Security Architect, and coordinate with the Security Operations Center and the CrowdStrike engineering team.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 9+ years of security engineering experience, including hands-on work on endpoint, software-as-a-service, or cloud security platforms.
* Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, or customizing CrowdStrike Falcon, such as policy authoring, integrations, detection logic, or console administration.
* Experience writing and tuning detection logic and security policy, and building automation for it with Python, PowerShell, or platform APIs.
* Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, including how prompt injection, data leakage, and excessive agency map to policy or detection logic.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (now Falcon Guardian) or Falcon Shield.
* AI gateways or AI security platforms (such as JetStream, LiteLLM, or Prisma AIRS), or security for Copilot Studio and Power Platform.
* Securing autonomous AI agents or Model Context Protocol servers.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

Role: Observability (O11y) Engineer (Enterprise Observability Platform)

Location: Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad (In-person)

We are building a next-generation Enterprise Observability Platform using Splunk Enterprise, ITSI, and Splunk Observability Cloud (O11y) for our clients. We are seeking a Splunk O11Y- Observability Engineer to lead the design, deployment, and enablement of observability capabilities across applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments.

This role focuses on instrumentation, telemetry pipeline engineering, service modeling, APM rollout, and onboarding new teams into the observability ecosystem. The engineer will work closely with application owners, SRE, DevOps, and platform engineering teams to deliver full-stack visibility and accelerate observability adoption.

  

Key Responsibilities

Observability Architecture & Implementation

* Design and implement observability solutions using Splunk Observability Cloud (APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, RUM, Log Observer).

* Build and optimize OpenTelemetry (OTel) collector pipelines for metrics, traces, and logs.

* Define instrumentation strategies for applications (auto-instrumentation, SDKs, agents).

* Develop service maps, dependency graphs, and distributed tracing configurations.

Application & Service Onboarding

* Partner with application teams to onboard services into O11y and ITSI.

* Define SLIs/SLOs, KPIs, and service health indicators.

* Build dashboards, detectors, alerts, and anomaly detection rules tailored to each service.

* Ensure consistent tagging, metadata, and observability standards across teams.

ITSI & Splunk Core Integration

* Implement ITSI service models, KPIs, correlation searches, and glass tables.

* Integrate O11y telemetry with Splunk Enterprise and ITSI for unified service health.

* Collaborate with Splunk Core SMEs to align ingestion, retention, and data modeling.

Telemetry Pipeline Engineering

* Deploy and configure OTel collectors across VMs, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services.

* Implement processors, exporters, and routing logic for efficient telemetry flow.

* Optimize pipelines for performance, cost, and reliability.

Enablement & Best Practices

* Develop onboarding guides, instrumentation patterns, and observability standards.

* Conduct workshops, demos, and training sessions for engineering teams.

* Provide architectural guidance on observability adoption across the enterprise.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work with SRE, DevOps, Cloud, and Application teams to embed observability into CI/CD and deployment workflows.

* Support modernization initiatives such as microservices, Kubernetes, and cloud migrations.

* Influence platform roadmap and observability strategy.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

* Hands-on experience implementing Splunk Observability Cloud (APM, Infra Monitoring, RUM, Log Observer).

* Strong understanding of OpenTelemetry (collectors, processors, exporters, instrumentation).

* Experience with distributed tracing, span analysis, and service dependency mapping.

* Familiarity with Splunk Enterprise and ITSI for integrated observability use cases.

* Strong Linux/Unix skills and scripting (Python, Bash).

* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms (AWS, and Azure).

Implementation & Architecture Skills

* Experience designing observability solutions for microservices, APIs, and distributed systems.

* Ability to guide teams through instrumentation and telemetry onboarding.

* Strong understanding of SLIs/SLOs, service health scoring, and reliability engineering.

Soft Skills

* Excellent communication and stakeholder-facing skills.

* Ability to lead workshops and influence engineering teams.

* Strong documentation and architectural thinking.

Preferred Qualifications

* Splunk Observability or OTel certifications.

* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, or similar tools.

* Familiarity with Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, or CI/CD pipelines.

* Experience in large enterprise, utilities, financial, or public sector environments.

  
Mandatory Skills: Splunk AIOPS .  
Experience: 5-8 Years .  
Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: Technical System Engineer (Cloud, Data & IoT)
description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

* Location

  Bengaluru
* Employment type

  Full Time Permanent
* Department

  IT & Digital Solutions
* Deadline

  2026-11-23

  

Candidate profile (text) - Default language We are looking for a hands-on Technical System Engineer to design and build the cloud, data and IoT foundation for our real estate portfolio. You will connect smart building systems, IoT devices and business systems into a scalable data platform that powers insights on energy, occupancy, maintenance and building performance.
  
  
This is a technical role for someone who has delivered large projects end to end, combines a cloud architecture background with full-stack / back-end development, and is strong in data engineering with Databricks and Python.
  
  
As a Technical Systems Engineer in the Group Real Estate, you will be at the heart of a foundational transformation in IWMS.
  
  
This means that you will:
  

* Cloud architecture: implement and maintain secure, scalable cloud architectures for real estate and smart building solutions on GCP, Azure or AWS.
* Data platform: Build and operate the data lake / lakehouse (e.g. Databricks, Delta Lake) for building, IoT, IWMS and business data, including ingestion, modelling and governance.
* Data pipelines: Develop batch and streaming pipelines in Python / PySpark and SQL for time-series sensor data, BMS data and system integrations.
* IoT & smart buildings: integrate IoT device connectivity and smart building systems (BMS, energy meters, occupancy and environmental sensors) using protocols such as MQTT, BACnet and OPC UA.
* Back-end & full-stack development: Build APIs, microservices and, where needed, web front-ends that expose building data and insights to users and other systems (including the IWMS / Planon).
* Large projects: Lead the technical workstream on large, multi-site projects – from solution design and estimation through build, rollout and handover to operations.
* DevOps & quality: Set up CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and automated testing; ensure security, reliability and cost efficiency.
* Analytics & AI enablement: Enable dashboards, KPIs and advanced analytics/ML use cases such as energy optimisation, predictive maintenance and space utilisation.
* Follow engineering best practice specified within Ikea Digital organisation

Key responsibilities (text) We believe you bring:
  

* 4–7 years’ experience in software, cloud and data engineering, including large-scale projects
* Data platform - Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data lake / lakehouse architecture
* Programming - Python, PySpark, SQL; plus a back-end language such as Java, Go or Node.js
* Back-end / full-stack - REST / GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture; React / Angular / Vue
* Data engineering - Advanced: Batch & streaming pipelines, Kafka / Pub/Sub, time-series data, data modelling, data quality
* IoT & smart buildings - MQTT, IoT gateways, edge computing, BMS integration (BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA), digital twin concepts
* DevOps - CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
* Security & governance - IAM, network security, secrets management, data governance, GDPR

This is our wish list!
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role are:
  

* Hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with a track record of delivering large, complex projects.
* Cloud architecture: background in cloud architecture on GCP and/or Azure / AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, managed data services).
* Software engineering: Full-stack experience with back-end focus – designing and building APIs, services and integrations.
* Python: Intermediate Python skills for data engineering and back-end development.
* Databricks: Hands-on experience with Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, workflows, Unity Catalog).
* Data background: Good data engineering experience – data lakes / lakehouses, ETL/ELT, streaming and time-series data.
* IoT & smart buildings: Experience with IoT platforms and smart building systems, including device data ingestion and building protocols.
* DevOps: Experience with CI/CD, Git, containers (Docker / Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform).

  
Nice to have:
  

* Real estate / retail: Experience in real estate, facility management or retail environments with many sites.
* Experience integrating with IWMS / CAFM systems such as Planon.
* Digital twin or BIM-based platforms.
* Machine learning / MLOps (MLflow) for energy optimisation and predictive maintenance.
* Energy management, ESG and sustainability reporting.
* BI tools such as Power BI, Looker or Tableau.

  
Personal Competencies:
  

* Passion to write code and build solutions.
* Balancing long-term design with pragmatic delivery.
* Clear communicator who can explain complex technology to business stakeholders.
* Curious and forward-looking mindset, with a willingness to explore and learn new technologies, identify their potential, and uncover business value through AI including opportunities to develop and work with agentic AI solutions
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.

  
Education and certifications:
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or equivalent experience.
* Cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect – Professional are a plus.
* Databricks certifications (e.g. Data Engineer Professional) are a plus.

Team vision (text) You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is leading the foundational transformation in HR Tech — with a clear vision: to bring trustworthy data to business leaders so they can make informed decisions. We sit at the intersection of HR, data, and technology, and we believe that getting the foundation right is what makes everything else possible.
  
  
We are a team that believes in:
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

### **What we all have in common**

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Gov.
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 5-7 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.
* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.
* Extensive Travel:The role is based out of Bangalore and requires extensive travel across various states in India, depending on project and business requirements.

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (5-7) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Senior Technology Engineer, Storage & Data Protection
description:
**About GSS**

GSS Tech Group is a technology staffing and managed workforce partner to leading banks, fintechs and telecom enterprises across the UAE and the wider region. We place senior engineers into the core technology teams of our clients and support them throughout their engagement.

**About the role**

We are hiring a Senior Technology Engineer to join the Storage & Data Protection engineering team of a leading UAE bank, working from Bangalore within the bank’s CTO Technology Chapter.

This is an engineering role, not an operations role. You will own the product engineering lifecycle for the bank’s storage and data protection platforms: design, build, standardise, automate and plan capacity for a consumable set of infrastructure products used across the bank. You will also play a key part in reducing technology sprawl and lowering total cost of ownership across the storage and backup estate.

You will report into the Technology Chapter and work day to day with the Compute Technology Platform squad, collaborating closely with the Security Chapter and the wider infrastructure teams.

**What you will do**

* Design, implement and standardise enterprise storage services across SAN, NAS, object and deduplication backup storage platforms
* Engineer and operate enterprise data protection platforms such as Veritas NetBackup, Dell Networker and Commvault, including architecture, policy frameworks, retention design, upgrades and lifecycle management
* Build and validate cyber recovery capabilities, including immutable and air gapped backup copies, isolated recovery environments and regular ransomware recovery testing
* Lead migrations and consolidation initiatives that reduce the number of platforms and tools in the estate and lower TCO
* Automate provisioning, configuration and health checks using Infrastructure as Code and scripting
* Own capacity planning, performance tuning and forecasting for storage and backup platforms
* Act as the senior escalation point for complex BAU issues and major incidents, driving root cause analysis and permanent fixes
* Ensure platforms meet the bank’s security, OS compliance and regulatory standards, working with the Security Chapter on design reviews
* Produce clear design documentation (HLD and LLD), runbooks and standards, and communicate transparently with stakeholders across teams

**What you will bring**

*Must have*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field
* 10+ years in infrastructure engineering or operations, with at least 3 years in a senior storage or data protection engineering role
* Strong hands on experience with enterprise SAN and NAS platforms (for example Dell PowerMax, PowerStore or Unity, NetApp ONTAP, Pure Storage, Hitachi VSP, PowerScale or Isilon), including provisioning, replication and FC zoning on Brocade or Cisco MDS
* Hands on experience with object storage (for example Dell ECS, NetApp StorageGRID, Cloudian or S3 compatible platforms)
* Hands on experience with deduplication backup storage (for example Dell Data Domain or PowerProtect DD, HPE StoreOnce)
* Deep, design level expertise in at least one of Veritas NetBackup, Dell Networker or Commvault, with working knowledge of another
* Practical experience with cyber recovery: immutability, retention lock, air gapped vaults and ransomware recovery testing
* Strong Linux administration skills, plus solid experience with VMware virtualisation
* Experience in large, complex, high availability enterprise environments, ideally in banking or financial services

*Highly desirable*

* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, and automation with Ansible, Python or PowerShell, including storage and backup REST APIs
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and integrating infrastructure automation into them
* Data protection for container platforms such as Kubernetes or OpenShift
* Configuring storage, compute and networking services on Microsoft Azure, AWS or OCI, including cloud tiering for backup
* Understanding of DevOps and SRE principles
* Vendor certifications from Dell, NetApp, Veritas, Commvault, Pure or similar

**How you work**

* A self starter who takes ownership from inception to delivery
* Calm and methodical under pressure
* Pragmatic, focused and keen to learn new technologies
* Builds trusted, professional relationships with stakeholders

**Why join**

* Work on the core infrastructure of one of the region’s leading banks
* A genuine engineering remit: design, automation and platform ownership, not ticket handling
* Exposure to modern data protection and cyber recovery practices at enterprise scale

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a talented and motivated AI System Performance Engineer. The role builds a strong understanding of AI training and inference systems and helps the team develop analytical models that project end-to-end system performance. Working across serving strategies, parallelism, collective communication, and interconnect behavior, the candidate uses these models to locate the architectural bottlenecks that limit performance and to recommend optimal system configurations for Intel architecture. A self-driven, hands-on learning by doing mindset and the ability to pick up unfamiliar workloads, tools, and architectures quickly are essential.

* Enable new AI workloads in analytical simulators, and model emerging multi-GPU deployment, parallelization, and communication strategies as simulator capabilities.

* Integrate and modify open-source simulators or analytical models for Intel-specific architecture.
* Perform what-if analysis by sweeping core count, memory/cache capacity and bandwidth, fabric bandwidth, GPU interconnect, and deployment options; deliver optimization and optimal architecture recommendations.

-------------------

description:
**Role:** Manager, Infrastructure, Platform, & Cloud Engineering

**Location:** Bangalore

**Full/ Part-time:** Full Time

  

**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

**About the role:**

Builds and operates infrastructure and cloud environments to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance. Manages services, costs, and architecture to support evolving business needs.

Job Description: Senior Cloud Architect - P5

### **Role Description**

The Senior Cloud Architect sets and evolves the architectural direction for Carrier’s cloud platform across AWS, GCP, and Azure. This role works horizontally across our product portfolio to ensure we build solutions that are consistently secure, resilient, and cost effective. The architect defines reference architectures, design patterns, and guardrails, then partners with Product Leads, Security, FinOps, and customer teams to put them into practice through Infrastructure as Code and automation. The result is a coherent, well-governed cloud foundation that product teams can build on with confidence.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Define and evolve reference architectures and design patterns across AWS, GCP, and Azure covering compute, storage, networking, identity, and data services that product teams reuse.
* Establish architectural standards and guardrails for security, resilience, and cost efficiency, and ensure they are applied consistently across the product portfolio.
* Translate architectural decisions into Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD pipelines so designs are repeatable, versioned, and easy to adopt.
* Lead architecture reviews and provide technical direction on design trade-offs, with a focus on security posture, reliability, and total cost of ownership.
* Partner with Security to embed controls into platform designs, including identity and access management, encryption, network segmentation, and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Partner with FinOps to design cost-aware architectures, set tagging and accountability standards, and build cost efficiency into solutions from the start rather than as an afterthought.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture leaders to establish architecture patterns and best practices across the Enterprise.
* Define standards for observability and operational readiness so that solutions are monitored, supportable, and resilient in production.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to product teams, mentoring engineers and guiding them in adopting standardized cloud patterns and best practices.

### **Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years in cloud or infrastructure engineering, with at least 6 years in a cloud architecture role designing solutions on AWS and/or GCP.
* Deep, hands-on understanding of core cloud services across compute, storage, networking, identity, and data, with the ability to design solutions that are secure, resilient, and cost effective.
* Proven experience defining reference architectures, design patterns, and guardrails that multiple teams adopt and reuse.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and version control (GitHub), including how to structure code for reuse across teams.
* Deep expertise in cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, encryption, and policy-as-code approaches to governance.
* Proven ability to document, communicate, and govern complex designs, and to influence technical direction across multiple teams.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience architecting across multiple cloud providers in a large enterprise spanning multiple business units and geographies.
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost management tooling, and a track record of building cost efficiency into architectural decisions.
* Exposure to cloud governance frameworks such as AWS Control Tower or GCP Organization Policies, and to policy-as-code tooling.
* Professional certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect Professional or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing architectural direction across large enterprise organizations.

**Benefits**

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary.

* Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave
* Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
* Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

**Our commitment to you**

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

title: Senior Manager — AEO, GEO & AI Search
description:
**Position:** Senior Manager of AEO / GEO & AI Search

**Company:** ContactPoint360

**Location:** Bangalore

**Type:** Full-Time

**THE GAME IS CHANGING. ARE YOU AHEAD OF IT?**

Ten years ago, everyone fought to rank #1 on Google.

Today, people are asking ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and other AI platforms who they should do business with.

Tomorrow? This is only going to get bigger.

**We’re not interested in watching this shift happen. We want to be ahead of it.**

At ContactPoint360, we’re a global BPO and customer experience company with approximately 5,000 employees operating across multiple continents.

We serve businesses that need world-class customer experience, outsourcing, and AI-powered solutions.

Now we want to win the next frontier of digital discovery.

And we need someone who’s obsessed with making that happen.

**YOUR MISSION IS SIMPLE.**

When someone asks AI:

* “Who are the best BPO companies in the world?”

* “What’s the best outsourcing partner for 100–500 customer service agents?”

* “Which BPO companies specialize in healthcare?”

* “Who are the top nearshore customer experience providers?”

* “What companies offer AI-powered customer support?”

* “Which BPO should I consider for utilities customer service?”

**WE WANT CONTACTPOINT360 IN THAT CONVERSATION.**

Not because we paid for an ad.

Not because we gamed an algorithm.

Because you’ve made our brand so credible, relevant, discoverable, and authoritative that we deserve to be there.

**WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO**

**1. OWN AI SEARCH. ALL OF IT.**

You will build and execute our Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategy.

ChatGPT. Gemini. Perplexity. Claude. Copilot. Google AI.

Understand the platforms. Study the results. Test relentlessly.

Figure out what works and what doesn’t.

Then execute.

**2. OBSESS OVER THE COMPETITION.**

Why is a competitor being recommended instead of us?

What sources are AI platforms citing?

Where are we missing?

What can we do better?

We don’t want guesses. We want answers backed by data.

**3. BUILD DIGITAL AUTHORITY.**

Work with our marketing, content, PR, and development teams to create the digital presence ContactPoint360 deserves.

Technical SEO. Structured data. Original research. Industry content. Case studies. Earned media. Credible citations.

Whatever legitimately moves the needle.

**4. TURN VISIBILITY INTO REVENUE.**

Here’s what matters.

We don’t care about pretty charts that don’t translate into business.

We want qualified prospects finding ContactPoint360.

We want enterprise buyers discovering us.

We want conversations, meetings, proposals, and ultimately new customers.

**Visibility is the beginning. Revenue is the goal.**

**5. EXPERIMENT LIKE CRAZY.**

Test ideas. Challenge assumptions. Move fast.

Some experiments will fail.

Good. Learn something.

We want someone who’s curious enough to ask better questions and relentless enough to find the answers.

**YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS**

**DAY 30 — KNOW THE PLAYING FIELD.**

Audit our entire AI search presence. Benchmark 100+ high-intent BPO buyer questions. Show us who’s winning, who’s losing, and where the opportunities are.

**DAY 60 — START MAKING NOISE.**

Execute technical improvements, optimize priority content, strengthen brand authority, and launch measurable experiments.

**DAY 90 — SHOW US THE DATA.**

What improved? Where are we appearing more frequently? Which experiments worked? What qualified traffic and business opportunities can we attribute?

And most importantly, what’s the next move?

We don’t expect miracles in 90 days.

**We expect urgency, accountability, and measurable progress.**

**WHO YOU ARE**

* You’ve got real SEO, AEO, GEO, and digital growth experience.

* You understand how AI search and LLM-powered discovery work.

* You’re technically strong and commercially smart.

* You know platforms like Profound, Peec AI, Ahrefs, Semrush, and Google Search Console.

* You can prove you’ve moved the needle for a real business.

* You don’t need someone chasing you for updates.

* You’re not afraid to challenge conventional thinking.

* You care more about results than job titles.

You don’t have to know everything.

**But you better be obsessed with learning faster than everyone else.**

**WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY**

If your entire strategy is publishing AI-written blogs and hoping for traffic, this isn’t for you.

If you need six months of meetings before taking action, this isn’t for you.

If you love talking about strategy but hate executing, this definitely isn’t for you.

We’re looking for a builder.

An experimenter.

Someone who takes ownership.

description:
**Summary**
-----------

Salary:

Competitive

Job Family:

Data Management, Architecture and Engineering

Location:

India - Bangalore IT Capability Centre

  

As a Data Engineering Manager at Dyson, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing and guiding a small team of data engineers within the Data and Analytics group. You will provide hands-on technical leadership in the Data domain, ensuring the team leverages a diverse set of Data technologies and remains adaptable to evolving requirements and industry trends. Your leadership will be instrumental in fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with business stakeholders to help prioritise projects and align data engineering initiatives with broader business objectives. You will be responsible for mentoring and developing your team, driving the delivery of robust, reliable data solutions that adhere to industry best practices. Additionally, you will actively contribute to technical design reviews, offering constructive feedback and ensuring high standards throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Your responsibilities will include designing, building, and optimising scalable data solutions for analytics, as well as establishing and maintaining efficient workflows and good practices across a global data engineering environment. You will champion clear documentation standards and lead efforts to enhance data quality, reliability, data lineage, and governance. Your expertise and guidance will support the professional growth of your team and the ongoing improvement of data engineering processes at Dyson.

Key Competencies

* 8+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or related fields

* Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring data engineering teams

* Proven ability to manage and deliver complex data engineering projects through all stages

* Expertise in designing, developing and optimising data pipelines and solutions

* Advanced proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, SQL, DBT)

* Extensive experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

* Strong knowledge of CI/CD, DataOps, and modern data engineering best practices

Strategic Leadership and Influence

You will take a central role in defining and executing data engineering strategy, actively shaping the vision and roadmap for data-driven initiatives across the organisation. You will lead a small, high-performing team, providing mentorship and direction to ensure successful project outcomes and alignment with business priorities. By instilling a culture of excellence in documentation, best practices, and workflow efficiency, you will drive continuous improvement and ensure the team remains at the forefront of emerging technologies. Your leadership will be instrumental in upholding and advancing the highest standards for data quality, reliability, and governance on a global scale.

Technical Proficiencies

With over eight years of experience in data engineering or related disciplines, you possess a deep understanding of the end-to-end project lifecycle and a proven record of delivering complex data solutions. Your technical expertise encompasses the design, development, and optimisation of scalable data pipelines and analytics platforms. You are highly proficient in leading programming languages such as Python, SQL, and DBT, and bring substantial experience with major cloud environments, including AWS, GCP, or Azure. Your knowledge of CI/CD, DataOps, and modern data engineering best practices allows you to set technical direction, conduct thorough design reviews, and provide constructive feedback that ensures robust, reliable outcomes. As the technical authority for your team, you guide architectural decisions and champion innovation in data engineering solutions.

description:

**Company Description**

Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.
  
  
At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

  
  
**Position Overview**

**Purpose & Scope -**

The Senior Manager, AI Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, and deployment of scalable AI solutions that accelerate Ralph Lauren's transformation into an AI-enabled enterprise. This role combines strong technical leadership with hands-on execution to deliver production-grade AI applications, agentic systems, and reusable engineering capabilities across the organization. This leader partners closely with AI Strategy, Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, Product, Security, Governance, and Business Technology teams to translate prioritized use cases into secure, scalable, and high-impact AI solutions built on Microsoft Azure and Databricks.

**The role is responsible for:**

* Enterprise AI and agentic AI solution delivery
* Multi-agent orchestration and intelligent workflow automation
* LLMOps and MLOps engineering practices
* AI integration, observability, and operational excellence
* Responsible AI implementation and governance adherence
* Engineering team leadership and capability development

This leader is expected to drive engineering excellence while enabling rapid experimentation, innovation, and scalable AI adoption across business functions.

  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**AI Solution Delivery**

* Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise AI solutions aligned with business priorities.
* Translate prioritized AI use cases into scalable, production-ready applications and services.
* Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to define solution requirements, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Drive disciplined execution across prototyping, engineering, testing, deployment, and production support.

**Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Design and implement agentic AI solutions using Azure AI services, Databricks, vector platforms, orchestration frameworks, and modern LLM ecosystems.
* Build and maintain multi-agent workflows, orchestration frameworks, and AI-powered automation solutions.
* Develop reusable patterns for memory management, tool usage, reasoning workflows, human-in-the-loop controls, and enterprise action execution.
* Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies based on business value, risk, and engineering fit.

**AI Platform Engineering**

* Contribute to enterprise AI platforms, reusable services, SDKs, templates, and engineering accelerators.
* Develop and maintain APIs, integrations, and shared AI capabilities supporting multiple business use cases.
* Partner with Data Engineering to ensure AI-ready data foundations and scalable access patterns in Azure and Databricks.
* Support technical decisions related to AI services, inference, model deployment, infrastructure, and integrations.

**Engineering Excellence & Operations**

* Establish and promote standards for CI/CD, testing, release management, monitoring, and operational support.
* Implement LLMOps and MLOps practices including evaluation, prompt management, experimentation, telemetry, and runtime optimization.
* Lead production-readiness reviews for reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency.
* Monitor performance and drive continuous improvement through operational analytics.

**Governance, Security & Responsible AI**

* Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise security, privacy, compliance, governance, and Responsible AI standards.
* Partner with Security and Governance teams to implement guardrails, auditability, policy enforcement, and risk controls.
* Support observability frameworks including telemetry, evaluation, performance tracking, and drift detection.

**Team Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of AI engineers and technical specialists.
* Provide technical coaching and hands-on guidance throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, engineering rigor, and continuous learning.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, performance enablement, and career development.
* Drive collaboration across strategy, architecture, data, infrastructure, product, and business teams.

  
**Experience, Skills, and Knowledge**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or data engineering, including technical leadership responsibility.
* 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams that deliver AI or machine learning solutions.
* Proven experience developing and deploying production-grade AI applications, agentic systems, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Strong hands-on engineering skills with the ability to architect, prototype, review, and troubleshoot AI systems.
* Deep experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, API Management, and cloud-native engineering patterns.
* Strong experience with Databricks, Lakehouse architecture, AI/ML pipelines, vector search, and scalable data processing.
* Experience building RAG solutions, vector database integrations, memory architectures, and enterprise knowledge-retrieval systems.
* Hands-on experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI SDKs, MCP-based ecosystems, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of LLMOps and MLOps, including deployment, prompt management, evaluation, observability, experimentation, governance, and runtime optimization.
* Experience with API-first architecture, microservices, event-driven systems, cloud-native platforms, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical and business teams.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience delivering agentic AI and multi-agent solutions in enterprise environments.
* Ability to rapidly prototype, evaluate, and adopt emerging AI technologies and practices.
* Experience building reusable engineering frameworks, accelerators, and shared AI services.
* Familiarity with AI-native commerce and Agentic Commerce ecosystems, including UCP, ACP, and autonomous transaction orchestration patterns.
* Experience in retail, luxury retail, eCommerce, or digital commerce environments.
* Relevant Azure, Databricks, cloud engineering, or AI/ML certifications.

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
AI Product Engineer (Full-Stack)

**Location:** Remote (India-based), Bengaluru preferred, with daily overlap with our UK and US teams

**Engagement Type:** Contract-to-hire, 3 months then ongoing

**Reports to:** CEO

About MarcoPolo Learning

MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.

Backed by top-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale. At the center of that mission is Audrey, our AI Teaching Companion & Coach for early-learning educators.

Role Overview

We’re looking for an AI Product Engineer who builds with AI by default and cares deeply about the product. You’ll partner closely with our CEO to shape and move Audrey forward. You’ll turn ideas into clear decisions, then build them end to end alongside a small, collaborative engineering team.

This role suits someone who leads through clarity and trust, brings people with them, and helps the whole team do its best work.

Key Responsibilities

* Partner with the CEO on product direction: shape priorities, test assumptions, and turn ideas into clear, buildable plans.
* Design and build AI features end to end, including prompts and agents, retrieval, and the experience around them.
* Put evaluation and testing in place so AI quality is measurable and keeps improving.
* Ship full-stack features across front end, back end and cloud deployment.
* Work hand in hand with fellow engineers: share context, pair on problems, and help everyone get more from AI tools.
* Communicate progress, risks and trade-offs early and clearly.
* Build with privacy and safety in mind, including FERPA/COPPA alignment.

  

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

* **First 30 days:** learn the product, the teachers who use it and the team; get hands-on and ship a first improvement.
* **By 60 days:** own a meaningful part of the AI experience and deliver improvements on agreed timelines.
* **By 90 days:** help shape the next phase of the product roadmap with the CEO.

  

What We’re Looking For

* 5–8 years of full-stack software engineering: React/TypeScript front end; Node.js or Python back end; AWS.
* You’ve personally built and shipped at least one production LLM application used by real users. What you’ve built matters more to us than years on a résumé.
* Hands-on experience with prompt and agent design, RAG (embeddings, vector search, re-ranking), and evaluating LLM output quality.
* An AI-native way of working: you use AI tools every day and can show the speed it gives you.
* Leadership capability: you’ve owned a product area or driven product decisions, and you influence through ideas, trust and collaboration.
* A genuine product mindset: you’re curious about the teachers who use what you build, and you let that shape your work.
* A collaborative style: you make the people around you better and handle different viewpoints with tact.
* Self-directed: you move work forward with minimal oversight and speak up early when things go off track.
* Clear written and spoken English; comfortable with technical and non-technical colleagues across UK and US time zones.
* **Bonus:** ed-tech or early-childhood experience; FERPA/COPPA familiarity; early-stage startup experience.

  

What to Be Ready to Demonstrate

Be ready to walk us through an LLM feature you shipped: what you decided, how you built it, how you measured quality, and what you’d do differently. The process includes a paid take-home build exercise (AI tools encouraged). Sanitized examples are welcome; please don’t share confidential employer or customer information.

What We Offer

* Fully remote role with flexibility over how you structure your day.
* Ownership of the AI experience in a flagship product, with real influence over its direction.
* Direct work with the CEO and a real voice in product decisions.
* A collaborative, family-friendly, mission-driven environment at the intersection of education, media, and technology.

  

Why Join Us

This is a rare chance to shape the AI product of a growing global education company at a defining moment, and to help take Audrey into thousands of classrooms. If you want work that’s visible, technically meaningful, and genuinely useful for young learners and their teachers, this is it.

*Note: This is an India-based engagement. Applicants must have the right to work in India; visa sponsorship is not available at this time.*

*MarcoPolo Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.*

title: Machine Learning Data Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

BlueOptima’s vision is to become the global reference for the optimisation of the performance of Software Engineers across all industries. We provide industry-leading objective metrics in software development. We enable large organisations to deliver better software, faster and at lower cost, with technology that pushes the limits of what has been done before.

We are a global company which has consistently doubled in headcount and revenue YoY, with no external investment. We currently are located in 4 countries: London (our HQ), Mexico, India and the US. A total number of 100+ employees (and increasing every day) from 22 different nationalities and with over 25 languages spoken.

We promote an open minded environment and encourage our employees to create their own success story in this high performance environment.

 **Job Description**

BlueOptima has a truly unique collection of vast datasets relating to the changes that software developers make in source code when working in an enterprise software development environment.

As a Machine Learning Data Engineer you will take problems and ideas from our clients and customer support teams, analyse what would be involved, whether the solution will solve the underlying problem, plan and develop solutions. Within time you should be able to provide your own pipeline of ideas or problems that we can tackle. As with many problems within the Data Engineering space, defining effective pipelines to gather, curate and manage the data is as important as selecting the best approach using ML techniques.

You will take responsibility for the end to end process, this means that you will own the initial exploration of the data, the development of a solution, design the requirements for ongoing monitoring of the solution once it is released and tackle any issues that arise from the solution. Solution ownership is a fundamental part of the role and it is expected that you would not only take this for the solutions you develop but encourage others to own and take responsibility for the solutions they are involved in.

You will use tools ranging from advanced Machine Learning algorithms to Statistical approaches and will be able to select the best tool for the job. This means both being able to suggest the cutting edge approaches to problems and just as importantly identifying when a simpler approach will provide a solution which is as effective. Finally, you will support and identify improvements to our existing algorithms and approaches.

**Your team:**

The Data Engineering team at BlueOptima accelerates value delivery for internal and external stakeholders by providing production ready solutions & actionable insights. We cater to all products within BlueOptima, supercharging their success through data driven innovation.

You will be working hand-to-hand with a diverse team with a variety of skill sets across the fields of Data Analytics, Machine learning & Artificial intelligence. Majority of the team is currently based out of our Bangalore office.

**Responsibilities and tasks:**

* Solve business problems using advanced Machine Learning and statistical techniques
* Identify opportunities to add value and solve problems using Machine Learning across the business
* Identify bottlenecks in skills, technology, and processes restricting the team's ability to deliver excellence
* Exploring vast datasets, both structured and unstructured
* Owning the final solution; coordinating with different teams including engineering and client-side teams to take a solution from exploratory analysis to deployed in production.
* Facilitate taking solutions into production, through active participation with the internal development teams
* Spec the requirements to solve a problem and identify the critical path and timelines and be able to give clear estimates quantifying any uncertainty
* Resolve issues and find improvements to existing Machine Learning solutions and measure their impacts
* Takes data-driven approaches to validate assumptions/issues and track progress on changes being implemented

 **Qualifications**

What You Need to Succeed at BlueOptima:

* Minimum Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Mathematics or equivalent.
* Minimum of 3+ years experience in developing solutions with at least 2+ years using NLP with Deep Learning preferred.
* At least worked in any of these tools: PyTorch (Preferred)/Tensorflow/Keras
* An in-depth understanding of a wide range of Machine Learning techniques, and an understanding of which approach is best suited for the problem at hand (structured and ill-structured)
* Strong statistical analytics skills demonstrated through data engineering or similar experience.
* Understanding of Python programming when building both applications and scripting simple solutions.
* A drive to not only identify a solution to a technical problem but to see it all the way through to inclusion in a product
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

Good to have (Technical requirements/ Previous experience)

* Experience with fine-tuning neural nets and explaining how the different layers work along with designing loss functions, custom metrics, etc.
* Understanding of word embeddings like word2vec, glove, Bert, Encoder-Decoder architecture, hugging face library
* Experience working with managing software vulnerabilities in a coding environment.
* An understanding of defensive coding practices.
* Experience with automating tasks to maximize time for more important problems.
* Experience with PostgreSQL or similar Relational Database.
* Experience with Data visualization experience (via Grafana, Superset, Tableau, or similar) is preferable.
* Be comfortable explaining very technical concepts to non-expert people.
* Experience in project management and designing processes to deliver successful outcomes.
* Experience with deploying via containers using docker, containerd, Kubernetes

 **Additional Information**

Why join our team?  
Culture and Growth:

* Global team with a creative, innovative, and welcoming mindset
* Rapid career growth and opportunity to be an outstanding and visible contributor to the company's success
* Freedom to create your own success story in a high-performance environment
* Training programs and Personal Development Plans for each employee
