title: Director, Software Engineering | Enterprise AI Platforms, Infrastructure & Automation
description:
Meet the Team
  
In Cisco Enterprise AI Platforms& Infrastructure (EAIPI), our vision is to architect, build, and scale world-class agentic AI platforms, foundation infrastructure, and developer ecosystems that power Cisco's next generation of intelligent products and services. We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform.
  
Our high-velocity team operates at the intersection of frontier generative AI, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and modern software engineering. We build with a steadfast focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, principled quality, and developer enablement—empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As the Director of AI Support& Automation, you will build and lead our Bangalore-based engineering pod as an elite 'player-coach' calibrated two levels below the VP. Combining direct architectural leadership with deep, hands-on systems development across MyAgent and Circuit, you will set the benchmark for AI platform reliability and quality.
  
You will enable the engineering organization to improve and optimize engineering processes and infrastructure, directing software systems development, application engineering, and software quality assurance for cloud-based and agentic AI platforms. Your directive spans across 5 core pillars:
  

* Pillar 1: Tier 3 Engineering& Escalated Platform Support: Act as the ultimate engineering escalation authority for MyAgent and Circuit. Lead hands-on debugging, root-cause forensic analysis, and kernel/runtime patch development for complex production failures, memory leaks, context bleed, and tool execution anomalies. Bridge the gap between SRE/L2 operational support and core platform architecture with zero-regression hotfix.
* Pillar 2: Premier AI Agent Test Harness& Evaluation: Architect and build an end-to-end, agent-driven test automation harness. Implement automated LLM-as-a-judge scoring frameworks, multi-agent simulation loops, deterministic task verification, and golden dataset benchmarking. Maintain uncompromising quality gates with >99% test pass rates across complex functional, regression, experimental, and safety workflows.
* Pillar 3: AI Software& GPU Performance Validation: Lead performance profiling, stress testing, and concurrency load and latency validation across dedicated on-premise GPU clusters and cloud runtimes. Optimize latency, token throughput, context cache utilization, and resource efficiency.
* Pillar 4: Modular SDK& API Developer Platform: Deliver modular, embeddable SDKs, React components, and headless APIs that empower thousands of Cisco software engineers to control, customize, and extend multimodal agentic experiences.
* Pillar 5: High-Talent-Density Team Leadership: Recruit, mentor, and lead a small, high-density pod (6–10 elite systems, AI, and test automation engineers) in Bangalore. Lead by example through daily code reviews, technical design RFCs, pair programming, and rigorous engineering craftsmanship.
* Technical Architecture& Testing Methodology:
* Deterministic Harness Layer: Unit and integration verification of MCP protocol compliance, tool schema validation, state machines, token exchange (RFC 8693), and memory storage persistence.
* LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation Framework: Automated scoring pipelines using calibrated frontier and on-premise judge models to evaluate grounding, factual accuracy, safety guardrails, hallucination rates, and task completion against versioned golden sets.
* Multi-Agent Simulation& Adversarial Red-Teaming: Automated agent swarms generating synthetic edge cases, malicious prompt injections, tool misuse attempts, and context overflow scenarios to proactively identify failure modes.
* Continuous Canary& Regression Pipeline: Automated staging deployment validation with automated rollback mechanisms, real-time latency tracing (OpenTelemetry), and semantic drift monitoring.

Minimum Qualifications
  

* Education: Bachelor's degree (B.Tech / B.E. / B.S.) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative STEM discipline from an accredited institution.
* Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 3+ years leading high-performing technical engineering teams and 2+ years of hands-on production experience with LLMs, agentic workflows, or AI platforms.
* Hands-on Coding Proficiency: Expert-level fluency in Python and modern TypeScript/JavaScript; strong working proficiency in Go, C++, or Rust for systems-level performance tuning.
* AI& Systems Architecture: Deep practical experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, Triton Inference Server, PyTorch, and vector databases.
* Modern Test& Performance Engineering: Demonstrated track record of designing large-scale distributed test harnesses, performance testing tools (k6, Locust, JMeter), browser automation (Playwright), and AI evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, Promptfoo, Eval Studio).

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Advanced Credentials: Master's degree (M.Tech / M.S.) or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Distributed Systems, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering from a premier tier-1 engineering institution or top global research universities).
* GPU& Infrastructure Acumen: Solid understanding of GPU compute infrastructure, CUDA memory management, high-density server configurations, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Academic, Research, or Open Source Contributions: Demonstrated academic depth or research contributions in distributed systems, compiler optimization, GPU parallel computing (CUDA/Triton), formal software verification, major contributions to tier-1 open-source AI frameworks/benchmarks, or recognized technical patents in AI/systems engineering.
* Player-Coach Leadership Archetype: Proven ability to lead from the front, write production code, conduct deep architectural reviews, and inspire an elite engineering culture without relying on bureaucratic middle management.
* Enterprise Executive Communication: Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence, interact, and present technical architectures effectively across engineering, product, and executive leadership.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

title: ML Engineer
description:
Position: ML Engineer

Location: Bangalore

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Experience Required: Upto 5 years

**ML Engineer, Matchmaking and Recommendations**
================================================

**THE PROBLEM**
---------------

We are looking for someone who can solve matchmaking humans.

For each user we have:

* Bio data and hard preferences (age, height, religion, city, and so on)
* Photos
* In-depth conversations with our AI about who they are as a person and what they are looking for in a partner
* Feedback they have given our AI on every person we have recommended to them

The question you will own: how do we use all of this to matchmake people successfully, so that the match rate goes up, and so that a larger share of matches become happy matches. A happy match is one where the couple has a good conversation, takes it off the app, or goes on a date.

This is a reciprocal recommendation problem: A recommendation only pays off if both people say yes, and a match only pays off if the conversation goes somewhere. That makes it harder than standard item recommendation, and more interesting.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
--------------------

Own matchmaking end to end. We have no fixed architecture. You form hypotheses, build fast, measure honestly, keep what works, and take the winner to production.

Things you will likely try:

* **LLM rankers:** post-train an open-weight LLM (Llama, Qwen, Gemma) to score candidates from a verbalized user context. SFT, LoRA, custom scoring heads, reward-weighted losses, vLLM serving. Netflix's GenRec (arXiv:2608.10257) is the reference style.
* **Transformer recommenders in PyTorch:** SASRec / BERT4Rec-style models over feedback history, cross-encoders, sampled softmax and negative sampling.
* **Two-tower retrieval with cohort features** (UMAP + HDBSCAN over conversation embeddings and behavior) for cold start.
* **User representations** like user embeddings, etc from text, photos and tabular preferences.
* **Labels and rewards:** define a happy match from noisy behavior, denoise it, weight it in training.
* **Reciprocal, supply-aware ranking:** both sides must say yes, and good candidates are scarce.
* **Offline evaluation** that predicts online results, then A/B tests.

You run all of it yourself: Python, SQL on Postgres, batch pipelines, GCP (Vertex AI, GCS, Cloud SQL) or equivalent. You read papers and turn them into working systems.

**THE DATA YOU WILL WORK WITH**
-------------------------------

* Structured profile and hard-preference fields
* Photos, with image embeddings and model-scored attributes
* Voice, Transcripts and LLM summaries of voice conversations with us
* Per-recommendation feedback: likes, passes, and the reasons users give us
* Outcome signals after a match: messages, calls, unmatches, off-app and date signals
* Product analytics (session and activity events)

Overview:

**Atlassian Architect**

Job Description

**Department:**

Business Technology – Atlassian Products

**Reports To:**

Manager, Atlassian Products

India – Bangalore (On-site)

**Level:**

Individual Contributor – Senior/Principal

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale. Atlassian – Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence – is the connective tissue of how work gets planned, tracked, and executed across the entire organization.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Atlassian Architect is the highest-level individual contributor on the Atlassian Products team, responsible for defining platform architecture, setting technical standards, and solving the most complex problems in HealthEdge's Atlassian environment. This is not an administration role – it is a design and engineering role. You will own the decisions that shape how the platform is built, governed, and extended, and your work will directly influence how thousands of employees across the company plan, collaborate, and deliver. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, the Architect will also shape the platform's AI readiness — ensuring the architecture supports Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo at enterprise scale.

You will serve as the technical authority for the Atlassian Products team – providing architectural guidance, mentoring Senior and regular Administrators, leading complex solution delivery, and acting as the primary point of escalation for problems that require deep platform expertise. You will also own strategic initiatives including instance governance, automation frameworks, API integrations, and migration or consolidation efforts.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Platform Architecture & Standards**
-------------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform architecture across Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and Atlassian Access – defining how these tools are structured, governed, and extended at scale
* Establish and maintain technical standards for project design, workflow architecture, permission models, field configuration, and Confluence space taxonomy across the organization
* Design scalable, maintainable solutions that balance user needs with platform health – avoiding configuration sprawl and technical debt
* Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities, product roadmap changes, and Marketplace apps – assessing fit, risk, and adoption strategy
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation including design decisions, standards references, and solution blueprints

**Complex Solution Design & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

* Lead discovery and solution design for the most complex stakeholder requests – those that require cross-project thinking, advanced automation, or architectural changes
* Translate ambiguous business requirements from engineering, IT, product, and business functions into well-structured, scalable Atlassian solutions
* Deliver end-to-end implementation of high-complexity configurations, including multi-project workflow frameworks, advanced JSM service architectures, and cross-tool integrations
* Partner with the Manager, Atlassian Products to define and manage the platform improvement roadmap, sequencing initiatives by impact and feasibility

**Automation & Scripting**
--------------------------

* Design and implement advanced automation frameworks using native Jira/JSM automation and ScriptRunner (Groovy) for complex workflow logic, validators, post-functions, and listeners
* Build and maintain REST API integrations between Atlassian tools and external systems including identity platforms, ITSM tools, and business applications
* Establish automation standards and reusable patterns that the broader admin team can follow and extend
* Review and quality-assure automation and scripting work produced by Senior Administrators, providing technical guidance and improvement feedback

**Migrations & Consolidations**
-------------------------------

* Lead or architect Atlassian migration and consolidation projects, including instance-to-instance migrations, Server/Data Center to Cloud transitions, and post-merger platform integrations
* Perform pre-migration assessments including configuration audits, data mapping, and risk analysis
* Design migration runbooks and execute or oversee technical migration steps with appropriate rollback planning
* Ensure data integrity, permission continuity, and minimal disruption to end users throughout migration events

**Enterprise Governance & Security**
------------------------------------

* Own Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, authentication policies, IP allowlisting, and audit log management
* Design and enforce the organization-wide governance model for Atlassian – covering project creation standards, permission scheme governance, license management, and app approval processes
* Lead license optimization efforts, identifying consolidation opportunities and ensuring spend is aligned with actual usage
* Support security and compliance requirements including access reviews, data residency considerations, and audit evidence related to Atlassian platforms
* Serve as the technical lead for any Atlassian-related security incidents, misconfigurations, or compliance findings

**Team Mentorship & Technical Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Serve as the informal technical lead for the Atlassian Products team – the person Senior and regular Administrators bring their hardest problems to
* Mentor Senior Administrators on advanced configuration, automation, and solution design, actively developing their technical depth
* Conduct technical design reviews for significant platform changes proposed by team members
* Contribute to hiring by participating in technical assessments for Atlassian Administrator and Senior Administrator candidates
* Represent the Atlassian Products team in cross-functional technical forums and architecture discussions

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 7+ years of deep, hands-on Atlassian platform experience with expert-level proficiency in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Atlassian architectures for large, complex organizations (thousands of users, dozens of teams)
* Expert-level proficiency in ScriptRunner (Groovy) scripting for advanced workflow customization, automation, and platform extensions
* Strong REST API experience with Atlassian platforms — building integrations, automating administrative tasks, and extending platform capabilities
* Proven experience leading Atlassian migrations or consolidation projects, including Cloud migrations
* Deep understanding of Atlassian Cloud security and governance including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and enterprise-scale permission management
* Ability to communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications strongly preferred – ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or Atlassian Certified Expert (ACE) designation
* Familiarity with how Atlassian platform architecture affects AI indexing quality and Rovo answer relevance
* Experience with advanced Marketplace apps at architectural scale (Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, Tempo)
* Exposure to enterprise ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and applying them within JSM at an architectural level
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and DevOps tooling that integrates with Atlassian (AWS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines)
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT platform integration or multi-instance Atlassian consolidation

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have completed a thorough assessment of the current Atlassian environment, identified the top architectural gaps and technical debt priorities, and established yourself as the go-to technical authority on the team. Within six months, you have delivered at least one significant platform improvement, established or formalized key governance standards, and are actively mentoring the admin team. Within a year, the Atlassian platform at HealthEdge reflects clear architectural ownership — well-governed, well-documented, and built to scale — and you have meaningfully elevated the technical capability of everyone around you.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates at scale. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who wants to be the definitive technical expert on a platform that touches every part of the business. You'll have the backing of an engaged manager, a growing team of administrators to mentor, and a real mandate to shape how the platform evolves. If you want to do the most technically interesting Atlassian work of your career, this is that role.

title: AI Deployment Manager
description:
Why RapidClaims

US healthcare providers are paid only after every visit is turned into billing codes and submitted as a claim. That work is manual, slow and error-prone, and it is getting harder: claim denial rates have nearly doubled in a decade, from 7% to over 13%, while provider margins have fallen from around 10% to just 1% to 2%. Fixing the revenue cycle is now one of the biggest priorities for every health system in the country, and AI is how they are trying to fix it.

RapidClaims is an AI revenue cycle platform. Our autonomous agents code medical records, improve clinical documentation and manage denials, across 25+ specialties, with 98%+ coding accuracy. Clients include Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), specialty physician groups, community health centers and hospital systems. The company has raised $11 million in total funding from top investors, including Accel and Together Fund.

What sets us apart is speed to value. Where incumbents need tens of thousands of records and months of implementation to cover a new specialty, we need a few hundred records and hours. That advantage only counts if every client goes live quickly, stays stable and keeps growing. This role exists to make sure they do.

Why this role exists

In AI for the revenue cycle, the model is no longer the hard part. The hard part is making it work inside a real provider's workflow: their electronic health record (EHR) system, their specialties, their payer mix, their coders and their habits. The companies winning this market are the ones that get clients live fastest and keep them stable at scale. For a client, the deployment is the product.

Every client goes through the same journey with us: a pilot to prove value, a go-live, a period of stabilisation, then expansion into more of their work. Each stage depends on several teams pulling in the same direction, and we are hiring so that one owner holds that together.

The team you will join is responsible for pilots and live clients. You will work with engineering, data science, operations and quality control every day. You will wear multiple hats: problem solving, design thinking, debugging client issues and getting them resolved, and working with operations to manage client volume and bring efficiency.

What you will own

● The deployment. Run pilots, take clients live, stabilise them and lead their expansion. You are accountable for the client's outcome end to end, and you are the

person who knows where every client stands today.

● The translation. Convert client needs into clear, prioritised asks for our teams, and convert our progress into updates the client can act on. Nothing gets lost between the client and the people building for them.

● The resolution. Trace an issue across data, workflow, model and people, route it to the right owner, and drive it to closure. You report problems solved, not problems found.

● The tooling. Prototype agents, prompts and automations that remove manual steps from this job, deploy them, and measure the impact. Where a process is repeated, you are expected to build rather than repeat.

● The product. Turn patterns you see across clients into product features and process changes, so that every client after yours runs on what you learned.

Your first 45 days

● By day 15. You understand how a chart moves through our platform and through a client's revenue cycle. You have shadowed a live account, sat in on client calls, and mapped where work gets stuck and why.

● By day 30. You are running a pilot: discovery, data and integration scoping, workflow setup with data science, and the first quality review with the coding and quality control teams. You have shipped one small tool that saves someone on the team hours every week.

● By day 45. You own a portfolio of clients. One automation you built is in daily use by the team, and one product or process change exists because you saw a pattern across clients and made the case.

How we will measure success

● Time from pilot start to go-live, and from go-live to a stable, predictable weekly volume.

● Volume moving on time for your clients, and how quickly stuck work gets unstuck.

● Accuracy and quality outcomes for your clients, and how quickly issues reach data science when the model is the cause.

● Expansion: more of each client's specialties, sites and workflows moving onto the platform.

● Manual effort removed from the team by what you built.

What you bring

● 2+ years of experience, with shipped AI work. At least one AI-driven solution you built and put in front of real users: an agent, an automation, an internal tool or a product feature. You are hands-on with prompting, agents and evals, and you can

walk us through what you built, how you tested it, and what broke.

● A fast learner. Healthcare billing and medical coding are deep domains. You do not need to know them today, but you need to pick them up quickly and enjoy doing so. We are betting on learning speed over prior domain exposure.

● A structured thinker. You break messy problems down MECE (mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive), so nothing is missed and nothing is counted twice, and you can hold that structure while the details keep changing.

● Comfort with data. SQL, Python or advanced spreadsheets, enough to answer your own questions without waiting on someone else.

● Clear communication, written and spoken. You will talk to clients, engineers, coders and founders in the same day, and each of them needs a different version of the same truth.

● Comfort with context switching. This role moves between a client call, a stuck batch and a prompt that is not working. It is not a role with long quiet blocks, and the people who thrive in it find that energising rather than draining.

● High ownership and a problem-solving nature. You start with "how do I fix this", and you want the zero-to-one journey with the mess that comes with it.

Good to have. Exposure to healthcare, billing or US insurance. A prior client-facing or operations role at a startup. Familiarity with agent frameworks, structured outputs and tool calling, or LLM evaluation tools.

What this role is not

● Not an implementation or project-management role where you run a checklist and hand off. You build, debug and own the outcome.

● Not a pure operations role. If building your own tools does not excite you, this will feel like the wrong job.

● Not a quiet role. Several clients, several teams, many open threads at once.

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

* Are you willing to work in Koramangala Bangalore office
* How many years of experience in AI
* How many years of experience in AI deployment
* Have you worked in Health care Industry
* How many No. of end-to-end deployment you have completed
* what is your team leading size
* Do you have managerial experience
* What is your current CTC
* What is your expected CTC
* What is your notice period
* Have you been interviewed by Rapid Claims before?

title: Technical Instructor — Palantir Foundry & AIP | Bengaluru
description:
Ontologize is the sole Palantir Training & Assessment Partner. We help Palantir customers and partners build the in-house expertise they need to develop and operate AI-enabled solutions independently.

We're hiring a Technical Instructor to lead live Foundry & AIP trainings for enterprise teams. This is an instruction-first role where you'll spend most of your time in front of learners — reading the room, adjusting on-the-fly, and making complex platform concepts land for audiences that range from developers to business users. The engineering depth serves the core job (teaching), because it's what makes the instruction credible.

You will be the second person in our Bengaluru office (Whitefield), joining a small, distributed company with teammates across the US, Paris, and Rio de Janeiro. The expectation for this role is 4+ days in office.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Deliver multi-day, in-person and virtual Foundry & AIP trainings** for customers and partners, owning the room from preparation through delivery and follow-up
* **Translate complex technical concepts for mixed audiences** — developers, analysts, and executives in the same session adjusting depth and language without losing either group
* **Build and improve curriculum** — develop new training modules, refine existing ones based on what you learn in the room, and keep materials current as the platform evolves
* **Create recorded and written content** as the role matures — tutorials, walkthroughs, and reference material (this is secondary to live delivery and comes later)

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **You love teaching.** This is non-negotiable. If you're on the fence about whether you want to be in front of learners every week and being a teacher, this role is not for you.
* **You have meaningful Palantir Foundry & AIP experience.** This comes from hands-on Foundry work implementing end-to-end use cases over 3+ years, delivering enterprise outcomes on the platform.
* **You have a strong technical foundation in areas such as Python, Spark, and LLM-enabled workflows**. You are not being hired as a developer, but your technical depth should make your instruction credible.
* **You communicate clearly, both in writing and in speech**. You can explain what matters to non-technical stakeholders in language they can use, whether that is an executive making a decision or a business analyst configuring their first pipeline.
* **You are proactive and autonomous.** You don't wait for work to come to you. You communicate about what you're doing before anyone has to ask.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Full-stack development experience (any stack — we care about the thinking, not the framework)
* Machine learning experience beyond LLM usage
* Foreign language skills (English is a must; anything else is a bonus)

**What Success Looks Like at 90 Days**
--------------------------------------

Independently deliver a full-day training on either our developer-focused or practitioner-focused curriculum, demonstrating:

* Technical correctness under pressure
* Strong Q&A handling
* Pacing control across 5–8 hour sessions
* Whiteboard fluency
* Alignment with Ontologize's standards for instruction quality

**Benefits and Support**
------------------------

We are finalizing our India benefits with local advisors and vendors. Our intent is to build a practical package around ownership, health, learning, and the realities of in-office work. The intended package includes:

* Company-sponsored medical insurance (your choice of plan).
* Learning support for books, tools, courses, certifications and focused skill-building.
* Support for developing as an instructor: practice sessions, delivery feedback, and time to refine your teaching craft between cohorts.
* Company-covered travel for client work, team events, and offsites under our travel policy.
* Lunch reimbursements and commute support for in-office days (within a reasonable monthly cap).

**Travel**
----------

Most trainings are delivered virtually. You will work primarily from our office in Whitefield, Bengaluru, and will occasionally travel to client sites in India for in-person sessions, typically four-day engagements. You should also expect to travel to the US once a year for company events.

**How We Work**
---------------

* Work intensely when you're at work; don't work when you're not at work
* Direct, candid, and respectful feedback
* We flex on scope, not deadlines
* Turn Slack and email notifications off when you're off

**Target start date: July 2026**

Compensation Range: ₹40L - ₹70L

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. **Job Title:** AI Platform Engineering Manager

  

**Role Overview:**

EY GDS's Managed Services “AI for AI” team is looking for an **AI Platform Engineering Manager** to own the deployment, scaling, and reliability of our agentic AI solutions across a complex, hybrid infrastructure landscape — multi-cloud, on-prem, and hosted model environments. You'll lead a team of engineers responsible for turning AI prototypes into resilient, enterprise-grade platforms that run globally, securely, and cost-effectively.

This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, and agentic systems architecture.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own platform deployment** for agentic AI solutions across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, as well as on-prem and hybrid-hosted model environments (open-source and proprietary LLMs).
* **Design and manage CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines** for model deployment, versioning, rollback, and continuous evaluation at scale.
* **Architect for scale and resilience** — ensuring platforms reliably serve 100,000+ concurrent users globally with strong uptime, latency, and cost-efficiency targets.
* **Lead a team of platform/infrastructure engineers**, setting technical direction, mentoring, and managing delivery timelines.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with AI Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Responsible AI leads, and Product Design to translate agentic workflows into production-ready systems.
* **Manage model-hosting strategy**, including trade-offs between hosted APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), self-hosted open-source models, and on-prem deployments for data residency/compliance needs.
* **Build observability and monitoring** for agentic systems — tracing, logging, cost monitoring, drift detection, and performance dashboards.
* **Drive security, compliance, and governance** of AI infrastructure in collaboration with Responsible AI and InfoSec teams, particularly given enterprise/regulated-client contexts (tax, cybersecurity, supply chain data).
* **Optimize infrastructure cost and performance**, balancing GPU/compute resource allocation across cloud and on-prem environments.
* **Contribute to platform strategy and roadmap**, advising leadership on build-vs-buy decisions, emerging tools, and infrastructure investments.

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience building or operating agentic AI systems or complex multi-step AI workflows is highly preferred.

title: Senior AI Governance Specialist
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

Senior AI Governance Specialist, ASSET MANAGEMENT

Northern Trust Asset Management (NTAM) is an over a trillion-dollar investment management firm entrusted by investors around the globe to help them navigate changing market environments, so they can confidently realize their long-term objectives.

NTAM has embarked on an ambitious plan to modernize its Data and AI capabilities and embed a data-driven culture throughout the organization. The Data Governance Specialist will pride themselves in taking a customer first approach to truly make it easier for our internal customers to protect, enhance and instill trust in our data to generate insight and deliver the best client experience.

The key focus of this role is to assist the company adopt AI quickly and safely. You will turn AI governance policy and standards into practical controls, assess AI use cases and models for risk, and give business teams clear guidance on what good looks like. You will work across Data, Technology, Risk, Legal and the business, reporting to the Head of Data and Analytics.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Support projects and establish responsible, safe AI practice across NTAM. Responsibilities include:

**Data management**

* Check that data used in AI systems has a clear owner, documented lineage, quality checks and appropriate access controls.
* Explicit evaluation of data completeness, suitability, ownership, lineage, quality and governance
* Maintain the AI inventory and link each model to its source data, classification and retention requirements. Extend inventory coverage beyond models and use cases to AI systems, platforms, agents, agentic solutions, digital workers and vended AI capabilities

**AI model risk management**

* Work closely with the Enterprise Model Risk Management teams and Front line AI model governance team to run risk assessments on AI use cases and models, covering bias, explainability, privacy, security and third-party risk.
* Support model validation, ongoing monitoring and issue tracking in line with model risk principles (independent challenge, documentation, performance and drift thresholds).
* Assist to develop frameworks to map controls to applicable regulations and standards, such as the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF and linked up with our NT AI Policy and Standards.
* Importantly, the role is about training NTAM AI key stakeholders, ie model owner, engineers, architects and data practitioners on how to perform these actions and ensure controls are in place so that this becomes a repeatable process.

**Safe AI adoption**

* Review new AI requests, advise teams on risk tiers and required controls, and escalate high-risk cases.
* Develop guidance, templates and training that make responsible AI use easy for non-technical colleagues.
* Report governance metrics and emerging risks to senior stakeholders and the AI governance committee.

**AI telemetry and guardrail monitoring**

* Help define and maintain the telemetry that shows AI systems are behaving as intended, such as usage, prompt and output flags, policy violations, model drift, error rates and human override rates.
* Review dashboards and alerts to confirm guardrails (content filters, access limits, data loss controls) are working as expected, and investigate gaps or false positives with engineering teams.
* Log and track incidents through to resolution, and feed lessons back into controls, thresholds and risk assessments.
* Report back to Senior Management on AI portfolio telemetry to ensure that there is transparency from different AI initiatives (prioritized by risk tiering) with clear action owner, target date, closure evidence and escalation points, rather than only tracking incidents through resolution.

**Training and change management**

* Design and deliver AI governance and responsible AI training for employees, managers and technical teams, tailored to each audience.
* Lead change management for governance rollouts: stakeholder mapping, communications, champions network and feedback loops.
* Measure adoption and behavior change (training completion, policy adherence, intake quality) and adjust the approach to improve it.
* Mentor junior analysts and set practice standards for the team.
* Interface with AI Intake process to check submissions for completeness, perform initial classification and routing using defined criteria, challenge unsupported assertions or unclear ownership, and escalate incomplete or potentially higher-risk submissions
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Explicitly include Technology, Data, Privacy, Cyber, Model Risk, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, TPRM and business teams, with responsibility for following up on information, actions and evidence.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify improvements to templates, trackers, reporting processes and documentation quality to make oversight more consistent, efficient and scalable.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 6 months: the AI inventory is complete and every use case is risk-tiered.
* Business teams get governance guidance quickly and rate the process as clear and useful.
* High-risk models have documented validation and active monitoring.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  

* Working knowledge of data management practice: data quality, lineage, metadata, classification and privacy.
* Proven domain knowledge in financial services
* Understanding of model risk principles and the AI/ML lifecycle, including validation, monitoring and bias testing.
* Ability to read a policy or regulation and turn it into clear, testable controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable advising senior and non-technical audiences, with a track record of delivering training and driving adoption of new ways of working.
* Practical, pragmatic mindset that enables adoption rather than blocking it.
* Bachelor's degree in data science, engineering, risk, law, business or a related field.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, healthcare or insurance.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11-7 or DAMA-DMBOK.
* Certifications such as AIGP, CDMP, CRISC or CIPP.

description:

title: Senior Staff Security Architect
description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Director, AI & Information Security

**Role Summary** We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Senior Staff Cyber Security Architect to design, implement, and govern security architecture across enterprise networks, endpoints, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and AI ecosystems. This role is critical to establishing security standards, driving secure-by-design initiatives, and ensuring our technology landscape remains resilient against evolving cyber threats. You will serve as a trusted technical leader, bridging business and technology to enable innovation through secure, scalable architecture.

**What You Will Be Doing**
  
As a Senior Staff Architect, you will define and maintain the enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs. You will lead security reviews for infrastructure, cloud, SaaS, and emerging AI initiatives while enforcing Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust principles. Success in your first 6–12 months includes developing a cohesive security roadmap, establishing robust AI and cloud security guardrails, and partnering cross-functionally across Engineering, IT, and Product teams to reduce critical risks while elevating our overall security maturity.

**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* **Define and maintain** enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs across network, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, and AI domains.
* **Architect and govern** secure cloud landing zones, security guardrails, and DevSecOps shift-left practices across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* **Establish and enforce** Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust Architecture principles, ensuring secure connectivity, micro-segmentation, and least-privilege access.
* **Lead the development** of our enterprise AI security strategy, establishing controls for Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), model poisoning detection, and responsible AI governance.
* **Design** enterprise network and endpoint security architecture, overseeing standards for NGFW, ZTNA, EDR, MDM, and secure SD-WAN.
* **Oversee** SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) and establish comprehensive controls for enterprise platforms (e.g., M365, Salesforce, Workday).
* **Develop** robust Identity & Access Management (IAM) strategies, including SSO, MFA, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and passwordless authentication.
* **Conduct** comprehensive architecture reviews, threat modeling, and security assessments to identify risks and recommend strategic remediation to executive leadership.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with Engineering, Product, IT, and Legal teams to integrate security throughout the development lifecycle and align with regulatory frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
* **Provide architectural guidance** during major cyber incidents, partnering with SOC and Incident Response teams to evaluate events and strengthen future security controls.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of comprehensive cybersecurity experience, with at least 5+ years in a Security Architect or Lead Security Engineering role supporting enterprise-scale global environments.
* Deep technical expertise across network, endpoint, SaaS, cloud, and emerging AI security domains.
* Proven track record of designing and implementing Zero Trust Architectures and managing enterprise risk.
* Experience developing secure cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the courage and ability to influence cross-functional leadership on security best practices.
* **Education Requirements:** B.Tech/B.E. in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or GIAC.
* Cloud-specific security certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
* Experience or certifications related to AI/LLM Security (e.g., CAISP) and data privacy (CIPP).
* Master's degree in a relevant technical or engineering field.

**Location**
  
Gurgaon/Bangalore, India — Hybrid / Remote

description:
**Organization:**

To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.

  

**Job Title:** Staff Engineer – Knowledge Management

  

**Location:** Bangalore

  

**Business & Team:**

The Chief AI Office (CAIO) drives the bank’s AI strategy, platforms, governance, and capabilities to accelerate the safe and scalable adoption of AI across the enterprise.

The Knowledge Management domain within CAIO creates the cognitive foundation of the bank by transforming business knowledge into trusted, governed, and reusable knowledge products.

As a Staff Engineer – Knowledge Management, you will work closely with Knowledge Governance & Framework Leads, Knowledge Platform & Engineering Teams, Business SMEs, knowledge owners, product teams, and DHP platform and DevSecOps teams.

  

**Impact & Contribution:**

You will directly support CAIO's objective of creating the bank's enterprise knowledge capability and trusted knowledge products that accelerate AI-powered transformation across the Group.

You will enable colleagues, copilots, and AI agents to access trusted, governed, and reusable enterprise knowledge, improving decision-making consistency and productivity.

You will help reduce duplication of knowledge, manual research effort, and rework by transforming fragmented information into reusable knowledge products with clear ownership, lineage, and controls.

You will build enterprise knowledge platform and retrieval capabilities that make business policies, procedures, controls, and operational knowledge AI-ready and safely consumable at scale.

You will strengthen governance, explainability, and risk management through metadata, provenance, permissions, evaluation, and auditability built into the knowledge lifecycle.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Enterprise Knowledge Products:** Design and build enterprise-scale knowledge products that transform unstructured information into trusted, reusable, and AI-ready assets.

**Ontology, Taxonomy & Knowledge Graphs:** Develop and maintain the enterprise ontology, semantic model, metadata, taxonomy, and knowledge graph that provide shared context across business domains.

**Knowledge Platform Engineering:** Engineer knowledge ingestion, enrichment, retrieval, and lifecycle management capabilities for governed knowledge products.

**Knowledge Governance:** Build and enforce knowledge governance controls covering ownership, lineage, provenance, classification, permissions, auditability, and lifecycle policies.

**Policy-as-Code & Decisioning:** Implement policy-as-code and deterministic decisioning capabilities to deliver consistent, explainable, and compliant AI outcomes.

**AI Guardrails & Retrieval Controls:** Develop AI guardrails, retrieval controls, and policy-aware access mechanisms to ensure only authorised and trusted knowledge is exposed to LLMs and agents.

**AI & Agent Integration:** Integrate the knowledge platform with LLM gateways, agent frameworks, evaluation frameworks, and AI platform services to accelerate safe adoption of agentic AI solutions.

**Quality, Evaluation & Observability:** Establish quality, observability, evaluation, and feedback loops to continuously improve knowledge accuracy, trustworthiness, retrieval effectiveness, and business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work across engineering, CAIO, CDO, product teams, business SMEs, and knowledge owners to translate complex business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.

  

**Essential Skills:**

**Knowledge Management & Semantic Engineering:**

Deep expertise in knowledge graphs, ontology engineering, semantic modelling, taxonomy, and metadata management for enterprise-scale knowledge ecosystems.

Strong experience in unstructured data processing, document understanding, information extraction, entity resolution, and knowledge enrichment pipelines.

Strong stakeholder engagement and product-thinking skills with the ability to translate business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.

**RAG, GraphRAG & Retrieval:**

Hands-on expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector databases, search technologies, and retrieval optimisation for AI-powered knowledge systems.

Experience building enterprise search, retrieval, discovery, recommendation, or similar knowledge capabilities is desirable.

**Knowledge Graph & Semantic Technologies:**

Hands-on knowledge of semantic and graph technologies including RDF, OWL, SKOS, SPARQL, ontology engineering, taxonomy management, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, and graph modelling concepts.

**Enterprise Knowledge Platform Engineering:**

Proficiency in designing enterprise knowledge platforms with scalability, reliability, observability, security, and cloud-native architecture principles.

Knowledge of ingestion pipelines, enrichment, retrieval, lifecycle management, APIs, integration patterns, and enterprise platform engineering.

**Knowledge Governance & Responsible AI:**

Strong understanding of knowledge governance, data governance, lineage, provenance, access control, compliance, permissions, classification, and auditability frameworks.

Experience implementing AI guardrails, retrieval controls, policy-aware access, evaluation mechanisms, and governance controls for safe consumption of enterprise knowledge.

**GenAI & Agentic AI Integration:**

Experience integrating LLM gateways, agent frameworks, AI platforms, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and model orchestration services.

Familiarity with agentic AI architectures, multi-agent orchestration, MCP patterns, and tool-based reasoning systems is desirable.

**Policy-as-Code & Decisioning:**

Ability to implement policy-as-code, executable knowledge, rules engines, and deterministic decisioning patterns to support explainable and compliant AI outcomes.

Experience with BPMN, DMN, policy engines, and executable knowledge is desirable.

**Programming Languages & Tools:**

Strong programming experience with Python as the primary language, together with TypeScript/Node.js and SQL for platform engineering, APIs, data pipelines, and AI integrations.

Experience with cloud-based AI, knowledge management, semantic technologies, or knowledge graph platforms is desirable.

**Risk, Compliance & Enterprise Knowledge:**

Knowledge of risk, compliance, regulatory, and control frameworks within highly governed financial services environments is advantageous.

Understanding of process intelligence, process mining, business capability modelling, and decision modelling to capture and operationalise organisational knowledge is desirable.

**Collaboration & Engineering Capability:**

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Ability to work effectively across engineering, CAIO, CDO, and business stakeholders.

Clear communication and documentation skills with the ability to explain complex knowledge architecture, governance, and AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

Strong ownership mindset with a focus on automation, continuous improvement, scalability, and reusable engineering practices.

  

**Education Qualification:**

Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.

Relevant cloud or AI certifications, including AWS, AI/ML, or Generative AI certifications, are advantageous.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe, or helping find cures for cancer.

**Division-Specific Information:**

At the Proteomic Sciences Division, we are transforming the understanding of human diseases through advanced protein biomarker discovery. With our innovative Olink solutions—including highly specific and validated assays that cover more than 5,000 proteins—our colleagues and technology empower scientists in groundbreaking research that will play a pivotal role in the future of personalized medicine.

**Location**:

This position is based in Bangalore, India. Office work is required 3 days per week.

**Job Description:**

Join our team as a computational immunologist (in single-cell analysis) and contribute to global healthcare and scientific innovation. As part of the AI Excellence team, you will apply advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI techniques to solve complex business challenges across our enterprise. In our collaborative environment, you will develop and deploy sophisticated AI solutions that are a fundamental part of novel products, drive operational efficiencies, and enhance decision-making capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

* A strong background in large-scale data integration and multimodal-omics data for biological systems is preferred.

* Experience querying knowledge graphs will be advantageous.

title: Principal Platform Engineer
description:
**Organization:**

At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.

  

**Job Title:** Principal Engineer – Knowledge Management

  

**Location:** Bangalore

  

**Business & Team:**

The Chief AI Office (CAIO) drives the bank’s AI strategy, platforms, governance, and capabilities to accelerate the safe and scalable adoption of AI across the enterprise.

The Knowledge Management domain within CAIO creates the cognitive foundation of the bank by transforming business knowledge into trusted, governed, and reusable knowledge products.

As a Principal Engineer – Knowledge Management, you will work closely with Knowledge Governance & Framework Leads, Knowledge Platform & Engineering Teams, Business SMEs, knowledge owners, product teams, and DHP platform and DevSecOps teams.

  

**Impact & Contribution:**

You will directly support CAIO's objective of creating the bank's enterprise knowledge capability and trusted knowledge products that accelerate AI-powered transformation across the Group.

You will enable colleagues, copilots, and AI agents to access trusted, governed, and reusable enterprise knowledge, improving decision-making consistency and productivity.

You will help transform fragmented business information into reusable knowledge products with clear ownership, lineage, provenance, permissions, and controls.

You will provide technical leadership for enterprise knowledge platforms and retrieval capabilities that make business policies, procedures, controls, and operational knowledge AI-ready and safely consumable at scale.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Knowledge Platform Architecture:** Own the solution architecture and technical design of core knowledge platform capabilities, including ingestion, enrichment, knowledge graph, retrieval, and lifecycle management.

**Ontology & Semantic Architecture:** Lead the design and evolution of the enterprise ontology, semantic model, taxonomy, and metadata standards to create consistent knowledge across business domains.

**Enterprise Knowledge Products:** Architect and deliver high-quality, AI-ready knowledge products that transform unstructured business knowledge into trusted, governed, and reusable assets.

**Knowledge Governance & Guardrails:** Design and build governance and guardrail controls into the platform, including provenance, lineage, policy-aware access, classification, permissions, and auditability.

**RAG, GraphRAG & Agentic AI:** Lead integration of the knowledge platform with LLM gateways, agent frameworks, and evaluation services to support safe RAG, GraphRAG, and agentic AI use cases.

**Engineering Standards:** Establish engineering best practices, reusable architecture patterns, quality standards, and conduct design and code reviews for critical components.

**Technical Leadership & Mentoring:** Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers and work with product owners, SMEs, and platform teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

  

**Essential Skills:**

**Knowledge Management & Semantic Engineering:**

Deep expertise in knowledge graphs, ontology engineering, semantic modelling, taxonomy, and metadata management for enterprise-scale knowledge ecosystems.

Strong experience in unstructured data processing, document understanding, information extraction, entity resolution, and knowledge enrichment pipelines.

**RAG, GraphRAG & Retrieval:**

Hands-on expertise in RAG, GraphRAG, vector databases, search technologies, and retrieval optimisation for AI-powered knowledge systems.

Experience building enterprise search, recommendation, discovery, and knowledge marketplace capabilities is desirable.

**Knowledge Graph & Semantic Technologies:**

Hands-on experience with RDF, OWL, SKOS, SPARQL, ontology engineering, taxonomy management, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, and graph modelling concepts.

**Enterprise Knowledge Platform Architecture:**

Experience designing enterprise knowledge platforms with scalability, reliability, observability, security, and cloud-native architecture principles.

Ability to define reusable technical patterns and architecture across ingestion, enrichment, retrieval, knowledge graphs, governance, and lifecycle management.

**Knowledge Governance & Responsible AI:**

Strong understanding of knowledge governance, data governance, lineage, provenance, access control, compliance, classification, and auditability frameworks.

Experience designing AI guardrails, retrieval controls, policy-aware access mechanisms, and governance capabilities to ensure trusted and authorised knowledge consumption.

**GenAI & Agentic AI:**

Experience integrating LLM gateways, agent frameworks, AI platforms, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and model orchestration services.

Familiarity with agentic AI architectures, multi-agent orchestration, MCP patterns, and tool-based reasoning systems is desirable.

**Policy-as-Code & Decisioning:**

Ability to implement policy-as-code, executable knowledge, rules engines, and deterministic decisioning patterns to support explainable and compliant AI outcomes.

Experience with BPMN, DMN, policy engines, and executable knowledge is desirable.

**Programming Languages & Tools:**

Strong proficiency in Python as the primary programming language, along with TypeScript/Node.js and SQL for platform engineering, APIs, data pipelines, and AI integrations.

**Risk & Compliance:**

Knowledge of risk, compliance, regulatory, and control frameworks within a highly governed financial services environment is advantageous.

Understanding of process intelligence, process mining, business capability modelling, and decision modelling is desirable.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Collaboration:**

Strong technical leadership with the ability to establish engineering practices and mentor Staff and Senior Engineers.

Strong stakeholder engagement and product-thinking skills to translate business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.

Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.

Ability to work across engineering, CAIO, CDO, business SMEs, product owners, and platform teams.

Strong ownership mindset with a focus on automation, continuous improvement, scalability, and engineering quality.

  

**Education Qualification:**

Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.

Relevant cloud or AI certifications, including AWS, AI/ML, or Generative AI certifications, are advantageous.

  

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.

title: AI Integration Engineer
description:
**1. Role Objective**

To design, develop, integrate, and optimize AI capabilities within the **TGIP Agentic AI Orchestration Platform (AAOP)** and its **Just-in-Time Applications (JITA)** ecosystem.

The role focuses on connecting Large Language Models (LLMs), developing intelligent agents, engineering prompts and personas, and ensuring AI-powered applications deliver accurate, reliable, secure, and cost-efficient outcomes.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. LLM Integration & Orchestration**

* Integrate multiple LLM providers, including OpenAI, Google Gemini, and local/open-source models.
* Develop intelligent model-selection and switching mechanisms based on task complexity, performance, and cost.
* Implement API integrations and manage LLM interactions within AAOP.
* Optimize token consumption, response latency, and inference costs.

**B. Prompt Engineering & AI Personas**

* Design and maintain system prompts, agent instructions, and AI personas.
* Develop department-specific and task-specific AI behaviors.
* Implement structured outputs and response validation.
* Improve AI response accuracy, consistency, and contextual relevance.

**C. Agentic AI Development**

* Design AI agents capable of executing business workflows.
* Implement tool calling, function calling, and MCP-based integrations.
* Develop multi-step agent workflows and orchestration logic.
* Integrate AI agents with business applications such as Odoo, Zoho, eBay, and internal enterprise systems.

**D. JITA Integration**

* Integrate AI capabilities into Genie Chatbot (GCB).
* Support Genie Voice Interface (GVI) for Android and iOS.
* Enable AI-powered widgets, dashboards, and enterprise applications.
* Coordinate with frontend and backend developers for seamless AI integration.

**E. AI Performance, Security & Quality**

* Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, relevance, and reliability.
* Develop safeguards against hallucinations and prompt injection.
* Ensure secure handling of API credentials and enterprise data.
* Monitor LLM performance, token usage, and operational costs.
* Collaborate with QA/QC teams to validate AI functionality before production deployment.

**3. Required Technical Skills**

**Skills**

Programming

Python, JavaScript, REST APIs

OpenAI, Gemini, open-source LLMs

Agent Frameworks

Google ADK, LangChain, LangGraph

Prompt Engineering

System prompts, personas, structured outputs

AI Integration

Function calling, MCP, API integration

Token management, latency, cost optimization

Ollama, llama.cpp, local inference

Data

JSON, vector databases, RAG concepts

Git, debugging, API testing

API authentication, secrets management, AI security

**4. Expected Deliverables**

* **Multi-LLM integration:** Reliable integration and switching between supported AI models.
* **AI persona management:** Standardized, reusable prompts and personas across TGIP.
* **Agent development:** Functional AI agents capable of completing defined business tasks.
* **JITA enablement:** AI services integrated with GCB, GVI, and other JITA applications.
* **Cost optimization:** Measurable improvements in token efficiency and cost per completed task.
* **Quality assurance:** Tested AI workflows with documented accuracy, failures, and limitations.
* **Documentation:** Technical documentation covering AI integrations, agent configurations, and deployment requirements.

**5. Responsibilities should focus on three outcomes:**

**1. Intelligence:** Selecting the appropriate model and designing the prompts, personas, and agent behaviors needed to complete a task.

**2. Integration:** Connecting AI capabilities to TGIP’s orchestration platform, business tools, and JITA applications.

**3. Optimization:** Delivering the required accuracy, reliability, and performance at the lowest practical cost per successful task.

* Health insurance

* Paid time off

* what's your notice Period

* Expected CTC

* AI Integration: 4 years (Required)

title: Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)
  
  
Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid – 3 days a week in office)
  
  
About Us
  
Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building finance, accounting, payroll and expense management solutions that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending.
  
Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed.
  
We're investing heavily in AI — building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production.
  
  
Technical Skills- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code.
- Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code.
- Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling.
- Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation.
- Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e.g., MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day.
  
  
Leadership & Ownership- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production.
- Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non technical audiences.
- At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams.
  
  
Mindset & Collaboration- Growth mindset — curious, always learning, and open to feedback.
- Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster.
  
  
Nice to Have- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes.
- Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted.
- Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling.
- Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching.
- Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure.
  
  
What to Expect- We value humility and collaboration — we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos.
- We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code — including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality.
  
  
#LI-RT

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The Impact You'll Make- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution.
- Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking).
- Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context.
- Build evaluation frameworks — both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) — so we can measure whether agents are improving.
- Create feedback loops: capture and mine traces, find failure patterns, and turn them into better prompts, tools, skills, and evals.
- Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform.
- Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring.
- Work with engineers and stakeholders to identify high-value workflows, ship quickly, and iterate on real usage data.
  
  
#LI-RT

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**Hello Visionary!**

We believe that a business can truly thrive only when its people are growing. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global and diverse team is here to support you—and challenge you—to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

We are looking for a **Senior Machine Learning Engineer / Data Scientist**

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Machine Learning Engineer / Data Scientist to join our team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in machine learning and data science, with strong experience in developing and deploying models in real-world production environments. This role requires an individual who works independently, takes ownership of projects, communicates effectively, and thrives in a collaborative team setting.

**You’ll make an impact by:**

* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement end-to-end machine learning pipelines for various use cases to improve our internal Siemens processes.
* Technical Leadership: Provide expertise in ML engineering best practices, including data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, deployment, and incorporating MLOps and LLMOps approaches for scalable and maintainable solutions.
* Project Ownership and Management: Lead projects from conception to deployment, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration: Work closely with an international team of diverse backgrounds, including engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders, to integrate AI solutions into existing systems.
* Communication: Clearly articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and team members. Comfort with proactively raising concerns, suggesting alternatives, and engaging in constructive debate when appropriate
* Mentorship: Mentor junior team members and contribute to the overall skill development within the team.

**You’re excited to build on your existing expertise, including:**

* Education: Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related field.
* Preferred 7+ Years of Experience in machine learning engineering or data science roles.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver complex projects.
* Strong Proficiency in programming languages such as Python.
* Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
* Experience with cloud-native ML development (Azure, AWS).
* Familiarity with large language models and natural language processing as well as experience with LLM frameworks (langchain, promptflow)
* Proven ability to deliver end-to-end projects (i.e. from exploration to endpoint serving)
* Knowledge of big data technologies (Snowflake, Spark).
* Experience with data visualization tools and libraries.
* Knowledge of software development best practices, including version control (e.g., GitLab) and collaborative coding.

**Create a Better #TomorrowWithUs!**

This role is based in Bangalore, offering the opportunity to work with teams that impact entire cities, countries—and the shape of things to come.

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Bring your authentic self and help create a better tomorrow with us.

We’re Siemens—a collective of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time, across more than 200 countries. We are dedicated to equality and encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.
